About the Team

At Miro, design is intrinsic in everything we do. As a business we are on a mission to redefine how great work is done, and as a design team we aim to make that as easy and delightful as possible.

The design system team owns the leverage point that lets that craft scale: every component, token, and pattern either propagates quality across the product or quietly leaks debt into it. As a part of our Product Design team, you will contribute to our design process, culture, and experience principles and set new standards for design quality.

About the Role

Miro is a canvas — an infinite, multiplayer surface where millions of people think, run workshops, map systems, and build together. Design is what makes that canvas feel considered: fast, fluid, alive, and unmistakably Miro rather than a framework's defaults dressed up.

You own the design system — not by writing the infrastructure that enforces it, but by deciding what "great" looks like and turning that judgment into something the system can pull into the design process.

The design system is AI-native, meaning that agents will generate the first draft of the UI, using the tokens, components, and patterns you've defined. That changes the job. It used to be enough to design a good screen. Now the job is to design the soul and rules a screen gets generated from — to encode taste, not just constraints.

This is a design-first role with a strong foundation in code. You think and communicate in prototypes because they're more honest than a static mock. You reach for a quick build to test whether an idea actually feels right, not to ship production infrastructure. You're not the person building the rendering engine; you're the person with the eye to know when the rendering engine got it wrong.

What you'll do

 - You hold and push the quality bar forwards; meaning you don't only define what great design and taste looks like, you encode it.

 - Identify the interaction patterns, hierarchy rules, and softer signals (rhythm, restraint, spacing that "feels right") that keep AI-generated UI from feeling machine-made, then work with engineering to get those signals into the guardrails that catch violations before ship.

 - Push token thinking into motion, easing, spatial transitions, and multiplayer states like presence and cursors — the aesthetic decisions that make the canvas feel alive. 

 - Partner closely with engineering, making sure performance constraints don't flatten the product into something generic.

 - Build the patterns, guidelines, and examples that make every designer and AI-assisted contributor faster and more confident. Write things down — foundation-level thinking compounds.

What you'll need

 - 10+ years of product design experience, ideally in B2B SaaS or AI-focused roles.

 - At least 2-3 years operating at a Staff / Principal level, with proven ownership of complex initiatives.

 - Comfort in code sufficient to prototype and validate design ideas, without being primarily defined by engineering depth — this is a design-first role with a strong foundation in code.

 - The ability to see the difference between fine and right, and to say why out loud: taste here is judgment you can articulate, turn into a rule, and hand to someone else — the kind that notices the 1px that's off, the easing a beat too slow, the contrast that technically passes and visually fails.

 - An end-to-end understanding of the product — where a pattern breaks down in a real user flow, or where a component that looks fine in isolation causes friction in context.

 - A track record of influence beyond your own output: setting a quality bar explicit enough that others can apply it, and connecting fragmented, team-by-team work into something coherent.

 - Craft signals including visual craft and taste, pattern recognition at scale, motion and timing as a design decision, multiplayer interaction grammar (presence, cursors, conflict, co-authorship), and real fluency with AI tools and AI-driven product moments — enough to prototype your own ideas without needing an engineer to stand up a first draft.

 - Systems and governance thinking: the ability to articulate the contribution rules that keep a system coherent as it scales, even if someone else writes the enforcement code.

What's in it for you

We want you to feel supported, connected, and ready to grow. Our global benefits package generally includes equity, a wellbeing benefit, a WFH equipment allowance, and an annual Learning & Development stipend. Join a diverse team where you can do your best work. Full benefits may differ per location. If you would like to learn more about location-specific benefits, please refer to our Global Miro benefits board. https://miro.com/app/board/uXjVG8Fi8Yc=/?moveToWidget=3458764661021134968&cot=10

   Research Strategy & Systems Leadership  
 
  Inform and implement the strategic direction for research planning and execution ensuring alignment with strategic priorities and impact goals.  
  Build, scale, and standardize institutional systems, toolkits, and operational blueprints across multiple teams to support effective research ownership and execution.  
  Drive the synthesis of qualitative and quantitative insights across projects to inform high-level strategic decisions, program designs, and organizational growth.  
  Serve as an internal and external subject matter expert, advocating for the critical value of grounded, evidence-based design research.  
 
  IRB, Ethics & Governance Management  
 
  Provide end-to-end oversight and strategic guidance on all Institutional Review Board (IRB) submissions, protocol adaptations, and ethics compliance in collaboration with YLabs Research team  
  Oversee the development of rigorous, ethically sound research protocols (including literature reviews, sampling strategies, and consent mechanisms) tailored to local review board requirements.  
  Manage recruitment and oversight of local Principal Investigators (PIs) to navigate regional regulatory frameworks, cultural nuances, and site approvals.  
  Support development of and ensure strict adherence to Human Subjects standards, global safeguarding policies, and data protection protocols across all field deployments.  
 
  End-to-End Field Execution & Methodological Direction  
 
  Design and lead rapid-cycle field research sprints utilizing immersive observation, semi-structured 1-on-1 interviews, and participatory focus group discussions.  
  Build and manage pipelines for recruiting and training local community researchers and youth field listeners.  
  Oversee t daily field debriefs, implement reflexivity and positionality checks, and mitigate researcher bias during in-person engagements.  
  Adapt research plans dynamically when facing unexpected field obstacles, security considerations, or shifting group dynamics.  
 
  Synthesis, Packaging & Senior Stakeholder Engagement  
 
  Translate raw, complex qualitative field data into structured analytical frameworks, including root-cause analyses, ecosystem maps, personas, and user journey maps.  
  Co-create and iterate insight narratives through participatory sense-making sessions with field teams and local community partners.  
  Synthesise and package research findings into high-impact executive summaries, deep-dive strategic reports, and compelling presentations for donors, C-suite executives, and senior leaders.  
  Translate youth-driven insights into actionable opportunity areas and strategic recommendations for innovation.  
 
  REQUIRED COMPETENCIES  
 
  Design Research & Mixed-Method Research Mastery:   Demonstrates mastery of design research, qualitative and quantitative synthesis, and ethnographic field methods, with proven success in managing multiple complex research projects simultaneously.  
  Autonomy & Strategic Leadership:   Requires no instruction on routine work and operates with complete autonomy on complex organizational initiatives. Makes high-impact strategic decisions independently.  
  IRB & Compliance Expertise:   Deep understanding of ethical research protocols, IRB application processes, informed consent procedures, and human subjects protection.  
  System Building & Prioritization:   Inherently displays best practices in delegation and team management, establishing systems and structures across teams to enable seamless research operations.  
  Adaptability & Complex Problem Solving:   Creatively shifts approaches when facing unexpected field obstacles; demonstrates best practices in navigating barriers and anticipating future challenges.  
  High Emotional Intelligence & Mentorship:   Models best practices in professional relationship building, mentoring team members, managing performance improvements, and navigating sensitive interpersonal dynamics with ease.  
  Justice, Equity, Diversity, and Inclusion (JEDI):   Models culturally competent ways of working; recognizes and addresses personal and structural biases, creates safe spaces for dialogue, and elevates marginalized voices safely and ethically.  
 
  QUALIFICATIONS  
  Required:  
 
  Minimum of 7 years   of professional experience in design research, user research, qualitative field research, or ethnographic research.Experience conducting such  in the economic empowerment sector is considered an advantage.  
  Demonstrated track record of leading end-to-end design research initiatives—from field immersion and protocol design to executive-level presentation.  
  Proven experience preparing and managing IRB applications and working directly with local PIs, ethics committees, or research approval boards.  
  Demonstrated experience building research systems, toolkits, or operational frameworks used across multiple teams or departments.  
  Substantial experience supervising, training, and mentoring researchers and cross-functional project staff.  
  Exceptional verbal, written, and visual communication skills, with a portfolio showcasing complex research synthesis translated into clear, actionable frameworks  
  Willingness and ability to travel up to 50% of the time to field sites across Sub-Saharan Africa  
  Proficiency with collaborative research synthesis tools (e.g., Miro, Mural, Figma, Dedoose, NVivo).  
 
  Nice to have:  
 
  Master’s or PhD in Anthropology, Design Research, Human-Centered Design, Sociology, UX Research, or a related field.  
  Experience living and working in Sub-Saharan Africa (particularly East Africa).  
  Experience working with vulnerable or marginalized youth populations.

e53fae0e2d514bcd.title: Director, Product Design
e53fae0e2d514bcd.jd: Director Product Design     Europe / Remote  Reports to the Chief Strategy and Product Officer     About Velsera    Velsera builds software that turns complex biological data into research insight and clinical answers. Our platforms work across multi-omic and multi-modal data: genomics alongside proteomics, transcriptomics and other omics, together with imaging, clinical and real-world data, at the scale of some of the world's largest biomedical programs. Pharmaceutical companies, biotechs, public research initiatives and diagnostic laboratories use our products to advance precision medicine.   We run like a scale-up: small teams with real authority, fast decisions, and AI woven into how we work day to day. We measure ourselves on impact for our customers and, ultimately, for patients.    The opportunity    You'd be joining as the design authority for our Seven Bridges Platform and the leader of design at Velsera, just as we rebuild how we design, validate and ship. You report directly to the Chief Strategy and Product Officer, and decisions that take quarters elsewhere happen here in days. Our product managers have already started turning ideas into working, on-brand prototypes with AI and put them in front of customers within weeks. The design foundations that make that speed safe are yours to build and own: design tokens, a component library, and the patterns everyone works with.   That's the shape of your influence here. Product managers prototype with the system you build, you review what customers will see, and once a concept is validated, production design belongs to you: journeys that hold up across every state, edge case and installation. This is a product bioinformaticians, scientists and clinicians rely on every day, and you set its bar.   This is a hands-on leadership role. You'll manage our product designer working on the clinical side of our portfolio, you'll build the design function as it grows, and you'll keep doing the craft yourself. There's no large design team to inherit; there's one to create.   The product is changing as fast as the craft is. Our users increasingly work alongside AI in research and diagnostic workflows, with dense, high-stakes data from many sources. Someone needs to rethink the journeys, trust models and information design of software like ours for that reality. That is a key remit of this job.   This role won't suit everyone. If you're looking for a mature design organization with settled processes, you won't find that here yet. If you want to build the system a whole company designs with, lead design for products with real clinical stakes, and do it at scale-up speed, we should talk.      What will you do?    Own the user journeys, flows and interaction design of the Seven Bridges Platform: partner with product managers on problems, outcomes and scope, then own how the experience actually works, from structure and states down to the number of clicks.     Build our design system from the ground up: design tokens, a component library aligned with our front-end code, and the standards that bring our product surfaces together under one visual language. The whole organization will prototype with what you build.     Keep rapid prototyping fast and safe: maintain the foundations PMs build with, review prototype quality before customers see it, and take validated prototypes through to production-ready design.     Manage our product designer on the clinical side: set goals, develop their craft, give honest feedback, and answer for the quality of design across both businesses. As the team grows, you'll hire and shape it.     Design for AI in the product itself: assistant and copilot experiences, AI-generated results that scientists and clinicians can trust and verify, and workflows where automation and human judgment work together.     Work closely with front-end engineers so the design system lives in code, not only in Figma.     Use product analytics to see where users struggle, make experience debt visible, and give product leadership a clear case for what to fix first.     Bring design judgment into strategy conversations at the leadership level.       Your first few months    The first version of the design system is live, with tokens and core components in Figma and in code, and product managers are actually prototyping on top of it. You've reviewed working prototypes before they went in front of real customers, and what we shipped is better for it. You and the designer you manage have a real working rhythm, with clear goals and honest feedback, and it shows in the work. And your map of our experience debt is on the leadership table with a clear case for what to fix first.    Requirements    What do you bring to the table?   You've spent seven or more years in product design, with senior ownership of user journeys on complex, data-heavy or scientific software.    You've built or led at least one design system that engineering genuinely adopted, and you know what it takes to keep one alive.     You've managed designers formally, not just mentored them, and the people you've managed got better and would work for you again.     You're comfortable having your biggest impact through a system other people build with, not only through screens you designed yourself.     You've chosen fast, ambiguous environments before, and you're looking for another one.     You already use AI tools to design, prototype and produce working software (we work with Claude, from design exploration through design-to-code), and you have well-formed opinions about where these tools help and where they mislead.     You've designed AI-powered product experiences, or you have a clear point of view on trust, transparency and human oversight in AI interfaces.     You're an expert in Figma, including variables and design-to-code workflows such as Code Connect.     You know enough front-end to collaborate credibly with engineers on components and constraints. You don't need to write production code, but you do need to understand how your designs become it.     You can operate as the most senior design voice in the company: comfortable with ambiguity, generous as a coach, and clear whether you're talking to executives, engineers or scientists.    Nice to have: experience with genomics, multi-omics, imaging, clinical or other life sciences data products, or another regulated domain; products delivered across multiple environments or installations; familiarity with component documentation tools like Storybook; experience establishing design practice in an engineering-led organization.       Why this position?   You get real authority over a core product and the design function itself, from day one, with a direct line to the Chief Strategy and Product Officer. You join a company that works the way it's asking you to work: AI-assisted, fast and hands-on. The work ends in research results and patient outcomes, which makes the pace worth it. And you won't inherit a design practice here; you'll build the one everyone after you inherits.    Benefits    Flexible Work & Time Off - Embrace hybrid work models and enjoy the freedom of unlimited paid time off to support work-life balance.  Health & Well-being - Access comprehensive group medical and life insurance coverage, along with a 24/7 Employee Assistance Program (EAP) for mental health and wellness support.  Growth & Learning - Fuel your professional journey with continuous learning and development programs designed to help you upskill and grow. df23e418ad147021.title: Product Designer (Trading)
df23e418ad147021.jd: We’re building the next generation of TN Trader — a proprietary, React-based trading platform designed for the needs of global CFD and spread betting traders. As our Trading Product Designer, you will own the design of our most complex and technically demanding product surface: the trading interface itself.  This is not a generalist design role. You will be embedded within the Trading UIs and Execution vertical, working closely with Product Managers, Product Owners, and front-end engineers to design trade tickets, charting interfaces, order management systems, and the full range of real-time financial UI that traders depend on every day. You will be expected to understand the domain deeply — financial instruments, order types, execution flows, risk displays — and translate that complexity into clean, precise, and highly usable interfaces across different devices.  You will work within a shared Figma design system, upholding and extending it with the same care and rigour you bring to your own output. You’re the kind of designer who finds satisfaction in a perfectly crafted component, a flawless handoff, and a build that matches the design intent pixel for pixel.  This role is remote, with required occasional travel to London.     Who we are   Trade Nation is a global CFD and spread betting broker. We help traders make better decisions through clear market insights, transparent pricing and a fairer approach to trading.  Since 2014, we’ve grown into a market-leading, low-cost broker with our headquarters in London and offices across Europe, South Africa, Asia-Pacific, and key offshore regions including the Caribbean and Indian Ocean. Our platform is available in 14 languages, making it accessible to traders worldwide.  Built on transparency and trust, and driven by our people, our focus is simple: helping customers trade more effectively. We do that by keeping costs low, cutting unnecessary complexity and using technology to put traders first.      Our commitments to each other    We have each other’s backs   There when we need each other most   We challenge each other   Be more creative, more curious, more bold   We thrive together   Taking our work to the next level   We form strong bonds   Through team building and social events   We don’t judge   Instead, we teach and are open to learning   We step up   Taking ownership and supporting each other to do the same    Responsibilities   Own the brief-to-delivery pipeline: receive briefs from business stakeholders, resolve ambiguity proactively, and confirm deliverables, format and success criteria before a single pixel is placed.  Deliver high-quality UI to specification and on agreed timelines, communicating schedule risks immediately and transparently.  Work with fastidious attention to detail within our Figma design system, adhering to strict tokens & variables, design rules and naming conventions.  Create, maintain and extend reusable components using atomic design principles, keeping the system clean, consistent and scalable.  Partner closely with front-end developers to produce developer-ready handoffs — covering interaction states, edge cases and responsive behaviour — and participate in QA to ensure implementation matches design intent.  Proactively identify gaps and inconsistencies in the design system and propose well-considered resolutions.  Self-review and lead design crits for your work before submission, and iterate with pace and a positive attitude.    Requirements    Proven experience delivering production-ready UI reliably, to brief and on time.  Deep proficiency in Figma, including design systems, components, variants, auto-layout, prototyping and developer handoff.  Strong working knowledge of atomic design methodology.  Experience designing and launching app and web-based financial products.  Experience working with remote development teams and producing spec-quality handoffs.  A track record of embedding customer feedback, analytics (HotJar, Amplitude) and competitor insight into design thinking.  Experience validating and refining through A/B testing and prototyping.  A genuine love of designing simplicity — no matter how complex or regulated the product.     Preferred requirements    Experience designing trading platforms or other tightly regulated financial products.  Working knowledge of HTML/CSS sufficient to communicate accurately with developers.  Experience with Storybook or similar component documentation tools.  Exposure to AI-assisted design tooling, such as Figma Make or Claude.

e8ffa4dd3a67e207.jd: Lyst is a global fashion shopping platform founded in London in 2010 and catering to over 160M shoppers per year. We offer our customers the largest assortment of premium and luxury fashion products in one place, curating pieces from 27,000 of the world's leading brands and stores. In 2025, Lyst joined Zozo, operators of Zozotown, the leading fashion e-commerce platform in Japan. This partnership marks a bold new era for Lyst, as we accelerate our vision and work together to transform the future of fashion shopping through AI and technology.  We're investing in our team to build the kind of personal, intelligent, and delightful experience our shoppers deserve, and we're only just getting started. Now we need a sharp design mind to help us get there.    Who are you  We're looking for a Senior Product Designer to join our team: someone who can bring outstanding design thinking together with a sharp instinct for what makes our users sign up, search, discover, purchase and keep coming back for more. A background in fashion or ecommerce is highly desirable; you'll understand our users and their world faster, and bring insight the team can build on from day one. Just as important is how you think: can you wrestle ambiguity into clarity, see past the next two sprints, and spot where AI can genuinely transform both how we build and what we build? We believe that in person collaboration and community spirit is super important, which is why we spend some of our time in the office and some of our time at home.    Time Off:  In addition to the 8 statutory bank holidays, you will receive 29 holidays per year. Lyst’s holiday year runs from 1 April to 31 March.    Competitive Family Leave Package:  This includes Enhanced Family Leave for those eligible, paid Time off for Dependents and Support for Fertility Treatment & Loss.    Clothing Benefit:  We want you to enjoy using the Lyst app and site as much as our customers, so we provide you with a clothing allowance to use on Lyst every year. Training Allowance:  We’re big on continuous learning and growth, so all employees are currently entitled to an annual training allowance of £1,000. This can be used to attend conferences, industry events, training courses and to purchase resources.    Pension Scheme:  Our pension provider is The People’s Pension. We offer a minimum employee contribution of 5% and 3% employer contribution.    Cycle-to-Work Scheme:  Lyst will purchase a bicycle from your chosen retailer, you will then receive a voucher to pick up your bicycle from them.    Social Events:  Frequent company wide social events including Christmas & summer parties, sports days, themed drinks, quizzes, cook alongs, as well as smaller team socials. We also have plenty of interest based groups such as football, running club, book club, culinary and more.     We want to build a world where fashion works for everyone, and we want teams that are just as inclusive. Diversity and inclusion is an integral part of our culture at Lyst. We recognise and celebrate the value and impact diversity brings to our company and are committed to ensuring this is a consistent focus, for which we are held to account. At Lyst we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. An expert in visual, UI & interaction design, with a refined grasp of micro-interactions and motion that create delightful, polished experiences. e8a73c205244b86b.jd: Innovation is and will always be the core of SAP Fioneer, and it is the promise of why we were spun out of SAP: agility, innovation, and delivery.  SAP Fioneer builds on a heritage of outstanding technology and a deep understanding of corporate and consumer demands. At the heart of it all it is simple: We bring financial services to the next level with innovative software solutions and platforms.  We are helping companies in the financial services industry to achieve speed, scalability, and cost-efficiency through digital business innovation, cloud technology, and solutions that cover banking and insurance processes end-to-end.  A global company, with rapid growth, innovative people, and a lean organization makes SAP Fioneer a place where you accelerate your future!  Description  We are looking for a creative, versatile and detail‑oriented Product Designer to strengthen our team in Berlin. You will work on digital products that shape how financial services operate, collaborating closely with product, engineering, and design teams. This is a generalist role: we're looking for someone comfortable across the full design spectrum – from UX research, user flows, and interaction design through to production-ready UI . This role is ideal for someone who enjoys crafting intuitive, production-ready UI while pushing for thoughtful and consistent user experiences, and who is excited to bring AI into the design process rather than around it.  About the role  As a Product Designer, you will be responsible for designing user flows, screens, and high‑fidelity mockups that bring our solutions to life. You'll own the end-to-end experience – understanding user and business needs, framing problems, and validating solutions – not just the visual layer. You will work with design systems, contribute to a unified product experience, and support cross-functional teams with production-ready assets. We also see AI enablement as a core part of this role: you will help us adopt spec-driven AI workflows for product design, using AI to accelerate everything from ideation and flows to prototyping and handover, and helping the wider team work this way too. You will also stay current on industry trends to help elevate our design practice.  Key responsibilities   Work collaboratively with product, development, and design teams to create user-friendly and visually coherent interfaces  Cover both UX and UI: conduct lightweight user research, translate insights into flows and concepts, and carry them through to polished, production-ready design  Design production-ready screens using existing design systems and guidelines  Create user flows, wireframes, and high‑fidelity mockups to support product development  Prepare and deliver final assets in the appropriate formats for handover to engineering  Leverage spec-driven AI and modern AI tooling to accelerate the design process — from generating and iterating on concepts to producing production-ready assets and specs for engineering  Help establish and improve AI-enabled design practices within the team, sharing methods and best practices  Stay up to date with design trends, tools, and technologies to strengthen our design capabilities    Requirements    3–5+ years of professional experience in product design with a focus on UI    A strong portfolio demonstrating your design craft and experience in interdisciplinary environments    Experience working with design systems    Industry knowledge in banking  Experience in the B2B, or financial services     Solid proficiency in design software, especially Figma    Strong understanding of user‑centered design principles    Excellent communication and collaboration skills    Ability to solve problems creatively and effectively    Proficiency in written and spoken English; German is mandatory     A start-up mindset and experience working in SaaS environments, ideally with familiarity in the SAP Fiori design system    Benefits   You will have the opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds in the industry on an incredibly ambitious project to shape the ever-evolving financial sector. This is an environment where you can have it all - the agility, enthusiasm and dynamism of a start-up, combined with the established expertise, solid market presence and extensive customer network of a more established organisation.  At SAP Fioneer, you will benefit from a flexible work environment that encourages creativity and encourages you to think outside the box, bring new ideas to the table, and challenge the status quo. You will become part of a diverse and global team that we are proud of and are constantly growing and reinventing. As an employee, you will have the chance to chart your own career path and take advantage of competitive compensation packages and progression opportunities based on merit.  We offer a comprehensive benefits package that includes occupational pension provisions, support for health and wellbeing, various mobility options like bike leasing and transportation allowances, as well as additional perks such as celebration rewards, meal programs, jubilee recognition, and relocation reimbursement.  If you have gotten this far and are looking for the right balance of teamwork, challenge, and the opportunity to grow and learn,  please send us your portfolio, ideally accompanied by your CV . If your qualifications fit the profile we are looking for, we will contact you in a timely manner.

42f422b291575e35.jd: 🌍 Global SaaS | $28M Series B Investment 📍 Remote in Europe     The Mission  As the Director of Product, you will lead the product organization to move with  conviction, speed, and evidence . You are responsible for leading a team of Product Managers, Designers and Product Operations to ensure we are solving high-impact problems and building the  leanest, most impactful solutions  for our customers and the business.  You will act as the primary strategic force for the executive team, front-running strategy and managing stakeholder expectations, owning the tactical translation of strategy into a coherent, high-velocity roadmap, so that the roadmap remains proactive, data-driven, and aligned with our commercial goals. Your goal is to be a "Player-Coach" who deep-dives into the domain with PMs to ensure excellent execution habits. You are the final gatekeeper who resolves blockers and scope disputes before they ever reach the CEO or CPTO, which will provide you and the teams with a level of autonomy in which to thrive.  You drive efficiency through an AI-First approach, while embracing SVPG style experimentation and pragmatic execution, and inject these principles into your teams. This allows you to closely align with the Director of Engineering and make Dual Track Agile a standard across the organization.     Key Responsibilities:   1. Elevating Product Discovery & Conviction    Advancing Empowered Squads : You will work to continually increase the level of empowerment within our squads. Moving beyond execution, you coach PMs to take deeper ownership of business outcomes, ensuring they are positioned to solve complex problems rather than just deliver features.   Continuous Discovery:  You own the standard for modern discovery. You ensure squads are in constant contact with users to (in)validate hypotheses before significant engineering resources are committed.   Bias to Action with Knowledge:  You move with high urgency but high conviction. Decisions must be rooted in user insights and market data, ensuring we are always "building the right thing."   2. The Product-Engineering Partnership (Dual-Track Agile)    Strategic Duo:  You work in a tight, peer-level partnership with the Director of Engineering to lead the "R&D engine." Together, you are responsible for the total health, culture, and output of the R&D organization.   Discovery vs. Delivery Alignment:  While you own the Discovery Track (validating value and usability), you collaborate daily with the Director of Engineering, who owns the Delivery Track (feasibility, scalability, and execution). You ensure these two tracks are synchronized and never siloed.   Resource & Trade-off Management:  You partner with Engineering leadership to manage capacity. You lead the difficult conversations regarding trade-offs between new feature discovery, technical debt, and maintenance, ensuring the business is always focused on the highest ROI activities.   3. Executive Communication & Stakeholder Management    The "Final Answer":  You are the primary gatekeeper for the product roadmap. You provide clear, definitive "Yes/No" decisions to executive stakeholders underpinned with knowledge of our customers and the necessary trade-offs.   Vacuum Prevention:  You identify misalignments early and resolve them across all swimlanes of the business.    Commercial Realism:  You translate high-level business goals (Retention, Revenue, Strategic Growth) into actionable priorities while aligning with the company’s core Key Results and Business Objectives.   4. Operational Excellence & People Leadership    Product Operations Mastery:  You view Product Ops as a strategic lever. You standardize discovery documentation and research databases across the organization to create a transparent, low-friction environment.   Outcome Accountability:  You manage the Product Scorecard and Rolling Roadmap. These must be high-integrity, automated "Sources of Truth" providing executive-level visibility.   Radical Candor:  You practice direct challenge combined with personal care. You are responsible for raising the "Product IQ" of your team—coaching PMs to think like owners and act with strategic independence.   5. Product Advocacy & Representation    Product Voice to the Company:  Serve as the primary representative of the Product organization in company-wide meetings (All Hands, Town Halls). You must be able to translate complex technical roadmaps into compelling narratives that inspire and align the entire business.   Evangelizing the Vision:  Actively advocate for the "Why" behind our product strategy. You ensure that Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success clearly understand our product direction, value propositions, and upcoming releases.   Presentation Excellence:  You possess elite presentation skills, utilizing the Pyramid Principle to deliver high-impact, succinct, and visually clear updates to both internal and external audiences.   6. Aggressive Scope Management & Lean Execution    The "Slicer":  You coach PMs to avoid "heavyweight" features. You have a relentless focus on building the leanest possible MVP, MSP, CMF, ILS solutions based on the need or pain. If a solution is over-scoped, you are the one who cuts it back to the core value.   Pushback & Scrappiness:  You teach PMs to find their “appetite” for investment into a solution and how to find "cheaper" ways to validate hypotheses. You empower them to push back on high-effort requests by proposing creative, lower-cost alternatives.   Deep-Dive Problem Solving:  You don’t stay at the surface. You sit with PMs to help them deeply understand core user problems to avoid building "to cover all bases" and relentlessly focus on solving the actual customer pain.      The Ideal Profile:     The High-Agency Leader:  You don't wait for permission; you identify gaps and fill them. You have a natural "bias to action" but are always grounded in data.   The SVPG & Cagan Practitioner:  You live and breathe modern product principles and know how to coach others to do the same.   The Elite Communicator:  You are a master of the Pyramid Principle. You can command a room, whether it’s a 3rd-person Exec meeting or a 200-person All Hands.   The Systems Thinker:  You look at the "R&D Engine" as a whole and work with your Engineering counterpart to optimize for both speed and quality.   Operational Source of Truth:  The Scorecard and Roadmap are automated and accurate, serving as the definitive guide for the executive team and the business.   The B2B SaaS Operator:  You have built and led product in a B2B SaaS environment — ideally with a sales-assisted and PLG motion and an ARR-driven commercial model.      Success Metrics (First 90 Days):     R&D Sync:  Established a seamless rhythm with the Director of Engineering; joint ownership of delivery velocity and discovery outcomes.   Strategic Visibility:  The "Rolling Roadmap" and "Scorecard" are live, automated, and being used by the Executive team without manual intervention.   Empowerment Baseline:  Documented "Discovery to Delivery" workflows for all 6 squads with clear KPIs for hypothesis validation.   Stakeholder Trust:  A measurable reduction in "Roadmap bypass" incidents; stakeholders rely on your "Final Answer." opportunities, predicting churn, or supporting revenue growth.   Demonstrated experience managing senior stakeholders and presenting data strategy and insights to executive/C-level audiences. "Non siamo qui per venderti bellezza; siamo qui per farti sentire bene." Raymond Cloosterman, CEO Rituals. 
 
Siamo un marchio globale fondato ad Amsterdam, nei Paesi Bassi, nel 2000. La nostra ambizione è quella di crescere in modo sostenibile, diventare e rimanere il marchio di lusso numero uno al mondo nei cosmetici. Rituals opera in oltre 800 negozi, 2700 shop-in-shop in 33 paesi in Europa, Asia, Medio Oriente e Nord e Sud America. Rituals è un marchio omnichannel che opera all'interno di Retail, Wholesale, E-com e Travel Retail.    Ruolo e funzione    In qualità di Stock Coordinator, svolgi un ruolo importante nel nostro magazzino. Sei responsabile di un flusso fluido ed efficiente tra il magazzino e il negozio. Oltre a essere una parte fondamentale del team, nel tuo pacchetto di compiti rientrano anche le attività esecutive, dall'arrivo della merce alla presentazione degli articoli in negozio. Insieme al team garantisci un magazzino strutturato e che le consegne e la merce siano processate in modo efficiente e corretto, coordinandoti con la sede centrale di Amsterdam in caso di problemi con la merce e con gli ordini.    Le tue responsabilitá    Siamo alla ricerca di profili talentuosi per il ruolo di Stock Coordinator:  La risorsa, che fará parte del team di vendita supporterá la Store Manager nelle seguenti attività:   Gestione ottimale delle scorte in magazzino e nel punto vendita. Per fare ciò, devi essere presente in negozio nei giorni di ricezione dell'ordine e nei giorni di conteggio/inventario. Una giusta dose di esperienza nel retail e di conoscenza della logistica.  Preferibilmente hai maturato almeno 2 anni di esperienza lavorativa in un ruolo simile.  Lavori in modo organizzato e orientato ai risultati e ai servizi, anche nelle circostanze più frenetiche.  Ti piace prendere l'iniziativa e proporre nuove idee con l'obiettivo di ottimizzare il processo.  Hai dimestichezza con gli strumenti informatici    Spiccate capacità comunicative e umane: entrate facilmente in contatto con gli altri e padroneggi la lingua inglese.     A guide to your benefits    Se voi vi sentite bene, i nostri clienti si sentono bene.  Ecco perché, in qualità di Stock Coordinator, avrai anche:   Un sistema di bonus legato ai risultati  Uno sconto del 30% sui nostri prodotti  La possibilitá di provare e ricevere gratuitamente i nostril prodotti  Opportunità di crescere continuamente partecipando a sessioni di formazione e corsi di leadership.  Il tuo percorso verso una nuova carriera   Cresci con noi e dimostra le tue ambizioni trasformando il tuo negozio in un luogo in cui i membri del tuo team amano lavorare e i tuoi clienti amano fare acquisti!       Join Rituals    Se sei la persona che stiamo cercando, non esitare e inviaci la tua candidatura. Ti contatteremo al più presto!  Your body, your soul, your rituals.  Il/La candidata ideale ha maturato una precedente esperienza nel ruolo di in contesti strutturati e preferibilmente nel settore Beauty.

Atteggiamento positivo, carattere proattivo e orientamento agli obiettivi. 9bb38be7683d1a3c.jd:
Inetum is a European leader supporting organizations as they navigate continuous technological change. 
With deep industry expertise, a strong innovation culture, and a scalable international model, we help clients transform their operations and generate sustainable impact across business and society.   Guided by European values, we empower local businesses to create positive impact and unlock society’s full potential. This vision drives us to deliver on our promises, attract the best talent, and turn uncertainty into opportunity, building a future where technology unleashes the possibilities within us all.   This role combines customer-centric product discovery, business analysis expertise, and AI-enabled innovation to drive meaningful business transformation.  This is not a purely technology-focused role, nor is it a traditional business analysis role. It is a strategic position focused on helping customers discover opportunities, shape innovative products and services, and transform the way they work by combining human expertise with modern technology.  You will operate at the intersection of business strategy, product innovation, digital transformation, and AI-enabled delivery.      Your Role   As an AI Transformation & Product Discovery Lead, you will help organizations transform ideas into measurable business outcomes.  You will work with business leaders, product teams, architects, delivery organizations, and technology experts to identify opportunities, shape future solutions, and guide transformation initiatives from vision to execution. Are you driven by the challenge of shaping the future of automotive technology through groundbreaking microelectronics? Do you thrive on transforming complex concepts into high-performance analog and mixed-signal circuits that power the next generation of electrification and smart power solutions? Join us and become a key architect of innovative ASICs, where your expertise directly influences the performance and reliability of tomorrow's vehicles.   In this position, you design and develop high-performance analog and mixed-signal circuits for complex Automotive ASICs, specifically for electrification and smart power applications. You own the complete development flow, from specification and architecture definition to implementation, verification, characterization, and product release.  You analyze and optimize analog architectures regarding performance, robustness, quality, cost, and manufacturability, ensuring first-class results. You identify, analyze, and mitigate design risks related to functionality, reliability, EMC, and ESD robustness. Simultaneously, you technically coach junior engineers and actively promote knowledge sharing and best practice development.  Last but not least, you collaborate with international development teams, customers, and cross-functional stakeholders, actively contributing to innovation activities, methodology improvements, and the shaping of future automotive semiconductor technologies. Our Product Compliance & Risk (“PC&R”) team sits at the centre of Wise’s product development function, supporting our cross-functional teams in delivering exceptional financial products for our customers while ensuring they’re compliant by design.  We’re seeking a highly motivated, customer-centric and proactive individual to join the Wise Global FinCrime PC&R team, to work across our Product and Compliance teams to take our AML programme to the next level.   This individual will work closely with our Global AML product teams to ensure our controls strike the right balance for our customers and our compliance requirements; detecting and preventing financial crime while maintaining a great customer experience and scalable operations.   
 This role works side-by-side with our Product teams in order to:     Focus on new products and features to ensure that scalable and compliant MVPs can be brought quickly to market.    Remediate issues identified with existing products and features to ensure that they remain compliant, scalable, and effective in detecting financial crime.     
 Your mission:     Ownership of PC&R’s approach to AML control design and risk detection strategy    Collaborate with AML product teams to help design controls and support interpretation of global regulation and expectations to ensure Wise’s in-house built AML capabilities are best in class    Identify and drive enhancements that could improve risk detection quality, unlock growth, and improve operational processes (including reducing unnecessary contacts and friction)    Use data to define the effectiveness of AML controls and support the implementation of an ongoing testing / assurance program    Work with and support Product and Engineering teams to implement and prioritise control improvements to strengthen the programme while finding ways to create efficiencies (faster deployment, smarter automation, better triage)    As improvements are identified in audits, regulatory feedback, incidents, or by third parties, define project plans and facilitate implementation end-to-end    Perform periodic reviews to ensure controls remain compliant and effective, reviewing changing regulations, supervisory publications, and industry guidance, and translating that into product-ready requirements    Contribute to the mapping and assessment of controls as part of the annual financial crime risk assessment, including coverage across typologies and regions     
 A bit about you   We are looking for someone passionate about payments, fintech and compliance risk management and with an eye on the future. You should have:    Minimum 7 years’ experience working within AML/financial crime, with a particular focus on implementing and enhancing AML controls (e.g., transaction monitoring, behaviour/risk detection, typology-based coverage, alerting/decisioning)    CAMS, ICA or equivalent certification desirable    Experience collaborating with product and engineering teams to develop AML and/or financial crime controls in an in-house product environment    Experience in automation of financial crime controls, including reducing manual effort while maintaining/improving detection quality    Strong data analytics skills (able to define what “good” looks like, interpret performance, and convert insights into control changes)    Clear communication, project coordination, and management skills    Wisdom, a world view and talent for thinking outside the box    Professionalism and high integrity    You understand the importance of providing clear rationales for teams and excel in doing so (especially where trade-offs exist between friction, cost, and risk)    You anticipate roadblocks, are resilient and not easily disheartened    Willingness to challenge teams and themselves on how to best serve our customers, while keeping processes robust and compliant    Willingness to travel as required        For everyone, everywhere. How do you build the trust it takes for a business to run its payroll through you, quarter after quarter, without a second thought? How do you turn hesitation into confidence, one predictable, well handled transfer at a time?  These are some of the challenges a Design Director will get to work on as part of Wise's global mission to build an open, fair and human financial system. High Volume customers are a smaller portion of our overall base, but a significant contribution to our business, and growing fast. We haven't yet designed and built tools specific to this audience.    
 Your mission   You'll lead designers, content designers and researchers working across the cross-functional teams that make up High Volume at Wise. Our personal and business customers move large, often life-defining amounts of money through us: property purchases, payroll, treasury operations, inheritance.    In this role, you'll own the vision and strategy for design across High Volume, and direct your team to remove the friction, unpredictability and lack of premium servicing. Many of these customers also need to send hundreds of payments at once, for payroll, suppliers or treasury operations, and today that's still a manual, clunky process. You'll help automate and simplify how large volumes of transactions get sent, so scale becomes an advantage rather than a burden.   This is a genuinely hands-on role: expect to be personally in the weeds on a handful of projects each quarter, not just directing from above. You'll build the systems, servicing experiences and financial products that turn Wise into the primary financial partner for our most valuable customers, at scale. 
    Here's how you'll be contributing     Partnering with your Product and Engineering leadership partners to provide unified leadership for High Volume, setting the vision, defining strategy and leading your teams to deliver it    Owning the design strategy for High Volume, shaping the design agenda across personal and business segments, and defining what great looks like across every surface    Staying properly hands-on: each quarter you'll pick up a small number of projects yourself, working the problem directly rather than reviewing it from the sidelines, and using that work to set the creative and craft standard for the team    Leading, mentoring and helping to develop all designers in the team, across product design, content design and research, accountable for their performance, growth and the quality of their work    Proactively integrating AI into the team's design workflow and operational practices, identifying where it accelerates craft, reduces friction and creates new possibilities    Creating vision with substance that influences the High Volume roadmap and shapes perspectives at the most senior levels of the business    Working with Design Directors from other squads to create a single, seamless experience for customers across the Wise product    Evangelising High Volume's design strategy across the tribe and wider business, connecting great design decisions to business outcomes and company mission

How do you build a unified requesting and receiving money experience that holds up across dozens of currencies, when every market has its own rails, its own regulation and, increasingly, its own way of getting money to a person? 
   These are some of the challenges a Staff Designer will get to work on as part of Wise's global mission to build an open, fair and human financial system. The Receive team at Wise exists so that anyone can get paid easily, quickly and cheaply, by any payment method, anywhere. 
   To get there, we need to ensure customers are able to receive payments in any market they live or operate in. They should be able to request money from anyone, anywhere, by any method. And all of it should feel like one coherent system rather than a set of separate features.      Your mission:   You will be the most senior designer in the Receive squad, reporting to the Design Director for Money movement. You’ll serve personal, business and platform customers, and work on experiences that hold for all three. 
 
You’ll work on growing the volume our customers bring into Wise, with the goal of doubling it by the end of 2027. This will require thinking across adoption, retention and acceptance, making design decisions that achieve move the needle whilst also improving the product experience.    
    Three problems will take most of your attention:  
      Comprehension . Making it obvious what we offer and how to use it. Customers should be able to find their details without asking us, and understand what a feature is worth easily.     Trust . Building experiences that are stable and reliable enough that customers can depend on them for income that matters. And when something does go wrong, giving people clear ways to understand what happened, repair it and recover.     Systems . Wise is both a provider of payment methods and a platform connecting other services, and the design has to hold both. That means patterns that scale as a single currency gains many ways to be paid into, including alias networks like PIX and UPI. Thinking in systems as well as screens.        Here's how you'll be contributing:     Owning the toughest design problems in Receive end to end, working the detail yourself and setting the craft standard for the squad through the work

c0654205ca0ea946.title: Sommerjobb 2027 - Design
c0654205ca0ea946.jd: Vil du tilbringe neste sommer på en av Norges beste arbeidsplasser?     En sommer som gir deg et innblikk i konsulentverdenen, prosjektarbeid, nytt nettverk, samt mye sosialt og moro rundt sammen med en fantastisk gjeng. Høres det interessant ut?    Hver sommer ansetter vi studenter som får jobbe hos oss i en 6 ukers periode, i våre lokaler på toppen av Posthuset i Oslo eller hos noen av våre kunder. Du får en unik mulighet til å bli kjent med Sopra Steria EGGS som selskap og knytte langsiktige kontakter.    Innen design får du jobbe tverrfaglig med andre studenter innen meningsfylte prosjekter.       I løpet av sommeren hos oss vil du:       Få teste ut hvordan det er å jobbe som konsulent        Jobbe i team med andre sommerstudenter på reelle prosjekter        Bli kjent og lære sammen med erfarne Sopra Steria-konsulenter       Tilegne deg masse ny kunnskap gjennom prosjektarbeid og fagsamlinger        Få god oppfølging fra veileder og våre designere       Delta på sosiale aktiviteter og bygge et verdifullt nettverk     Hos oss kan du på sikt jobbe som konsulent innenfor en rekke forskjellige fagområder som du kan lese mer om her. Mulighetene er mange da vi dekker hele verdikjeden i prosjekter relatert til digitalisering, innovasjon og bærekraft.          Vi ser etter deg som:       Er på ditt 4. studieår       Studerer noe knyttet til design, UX, tjenestedesign eller lignende       Tenker at det vi kan tilby, matcher dine ønsker for en sommerjobb        Er nysgjerrig på og motivert for å teste ut konsulentlivet        Har karakterer som gjør deg og de rundt deg stolte       Er opptatt av at design skaper en bedre hverdag for ekte mennesker der ute     Vi tror at du vil oppleve mestring og ha det gøy som konsulent hos oss gjennom sommeren dersom du anser deg selv som en god samarbeidspartner og relasjonsbygger. I tillegg tror vi det er en fordel å like struktur og orden, være målbevisst, profesjonell og kundeorientert.       Er du interessert, send oss en søknad hvor du begrunner hvorfor du kan tenke deg en sommerjobb hos oss i Sopra Steria og spesifiserer hvilke fagområde(r) du er interessert i. Husk å legge ved karakterutskrifter fra hele studieløpet, inkludert VGS-karakterer og portefølje når du sender inn søknad. Søknader uten karakterer eller portefølje vedlagt vil ikke bli vurdert.        Sommerjobbperioden i 2027 begynner 21.06.2027 og varer i seks uker.     I Sopra Steria benytter vi asynkrone videointervjuer som en del av vår rekrutteringsprosess av sommerstudenter. Mer informasjon om rekrutteringsprosessen finner du ved å trykke “søk her”.     Hørtes dette ut som noe for deg? Da håper vi at du vil sende oss din  CV, portefølje og foreløpig karakterutskrift/vitnemål.  Husk å legge ved karakterutskrifter fra hele studieløpet frem til nå, inkludert VGS-karakterer. Vi ber ikke om søknadsbrev, men ønsker at du svarer på noen spørsmål som en del av søknaden. Søknader vurderes fortløpende.   Sopra Steria har kunder og prosjekter som kan kreve sikkerhetsklarering på ulike nivåer.    Søknadsfrist: 1. oktober 2026        Vi er Norges ledende konsulentselskap innen digitalisering, innovasjon og bærekraft. I Sopra Steria bistår vi våre kunder innen privat og offentlig sektor med å bli fremtidens virksomheter. I en årrekke har vi vært rangert som en av Norges beste arbeidsplasser. Du finner oss i Oslo, Stavanger, Trondheim, Bergen, Drammen, Hamar, Fredrikstad, Kristiansand og Tromsø.

4177c5c577d4fee7.title: Senior Digital Designer UX/UI
4177c5c577d4fee7.jd: Har du evnen til å se det store bildet, utfordre etablerte sannheter og levere løsninger som virkelig gjør en forskjell? Vi ser nå etter en engasjert UX/UI designere som har lyst til å bli en del av Sopra Steria EGGS!  Vi er et av landets største designmiljø, med over hundre designere som har en unik fagbredde innen interaksjonsdesign, tjenestedesign, business design, innholdsdesign, Mixed reality og UX research. Sammen med utviklere og forretningsrådgivere jobber vi tett med noen av landets største virksomheter, der vi går hele veien fra idé til ferdig implementerte løsninger. Mange av våre produkter brukes daglig av hele Norges befolkning, så hos oss vil du få mulighet til å lage mye viktig for mange.  Vi er opptatt av å ha et åpent og delende miljø der vi spiller hverandre gode gjennom godt samarbeid. Nysgjerrighet og faglig utvikling står sterkt og vi har skapt et miljø der det er rom for å feile og lære. Hos oss vil du få varierte oppdrag, tydelig karrierevei og et unikt og sterkt fagfellesskap som støtter deg i ryggen.   Hvem ser vi etter?   Som konsulent hos oss vil du få et helhetlig ansvar i designprosessen, fra innsikt til implementering. Det er viktig for oss å omsette innsikt til løsninger som ikke bare ser gode ut, men som fungerer i praksis for både brukere og organisasjon.  Rollen krever trygghet, faglig tyngde og evne til å utfordre både kunder og kollegaer på en givende måte. Du kommuniserer klart og presist, både visuelt og muntlig, og håndterer komplekse kontekster, enten det gjelder fagområde, teknologi eller organisasjon. Du har god evne til selvledelse, trives godt med samarbeid og har et ønske om å styrke og videreutvikle designfagmiljøet.  Som en del av et av Norges største teknologimiljøer vil du ha en viktig rolle i å synliggjøre verdien av design og bidra til at design blir en sentral del av helheten i produkt- og tjenesteutviklingen.   Kvalifikasjoner    Fullført relevant høyere utdannelse    Minimum 5 års relevant erfaring   Dokumentert erfaring med komplekse prosjekter som konsulent, gjerne fra større organisasjoner og produktteam  Erfaring fra konsulentbransjen  Solid kompetanse og høy ferdighet i Figma eller lignende designverktøy  Erfaring med brukerinnsikt og brukertesting  Portfolio som ikke bare viser visuelt gode prosjekter, men en god prosess, verdiskapning, strategisk forståelse og evne til å levere i komplekse prosjekter  Gode skriftlig og muntlig norskkunnskaper   Det er også en fordel om du har   Erfaring med AI og vibbekoding  Erfaring med designsystemer    Hva får du hos oss?   Vi tror på trivsel både på og utenfor jobb. Du får blant annet:   6 ukers ferie  Gode pensjons- og forsikringsordninger  Tilgang til en mengde kurs og læringsmuligheter  Dekning av 18 000 kroner til mobil og headset, samt mobilabonnement og bredbånd  Valg mellom MacBook Pro eller PC  Tilgang til bedriftshytter og rabatter hos treningssentre og butikker    Kontaktinformasjon:   For spørsmål knyttet til stillingen ta kontakt med Brian Dale (brian.dale@soprasteria.com), for spørsmål knyttet til rekrutteringsprosessen ta kontakt med Glenn Bøe (glenn.boe@soprasteria.com).   Klar for å søke? Send oss din portfolio med prosjekter du er stolt av og en CV    Søknadsfrist: 29.09.26   Sopra Steria har kunder og prosjekter som kan kreve sikkerhetsklarering på ulike nivåer.  Vi selekterer og inviterer kandidater til intervju fortløpende.      We are Norway's leading consulting company in digitisation, innovation and sustainability and for a number of years have been ranked as one of Norway’s best workplaces. As one of Europe's largest consulting companies, we assist large private companies and public companies in taking digital leadership.  We are committed to creating value for our customers and society and aim to create a better and more sustainable future. In Norway we have offices in Oslo, Stavanger, Trondheim, Drammen, Bergen, Kristiansand, Fredrikstad, Hamar og Tromsø.  We are more than 3300 employees in Norway and had a turnover of more than NOK 5,9 billion in 2024.  We were named Consultancy of the Year, Norway, in 2023 and 2024.

c24e1f9cfaa99faa.title: Telecom Sector | UX/UI Designer
c24e1f9cfaa99faa.jd: At Devoteam, we believe that technology with strong human values can actively drive change for the better. Discover how Tech for People unlocks the future, creating a positive impact on the people and the world around us. We are a global leading player in Digital Transformation for leading organisations across EMEA, with a revenue of €652M.
