The division has about 6,500 employees and is structured around two segments: Road & Rail and Public & Commercial Places.   In the  Public and Commercial Places  segment, our  Structural Engineering team  supports clients in the planning and delivery of a wide range of building and infrastructure projects in Switzerland. With offices in Zurich, Chur and Rapperswil and around 50 colleagues across the relevant sections, we combine local presence with interdisciplinary expertise to develop efficient, sustainable and high-quality structural solutions.  You will join our Structural Engineering team based in one of our  Design Centers in Poland  — Łódź, Poznań or Kraków. In this role, you will contribute to exciting projects in the field of public and commercial buildings and support the development of structural BIM models, drawings and documentation in close collaboration with engineers and project teams across different locations. Through cross-location collaboration and knowledge sharing, you will have the opportunity to further develop your technical skills and benefit from a strong professional network.  Based on your qualifications and experience we have opening for the following positions: Assistant Structural Designer, Junior Structural Designer, Structural Designer and Senior Structural Designer.   Your key responsibilities are:    Creation of 3D BIM models for structural systems in building construction, including reinforced concrete, steel and timber structures, as well as excavation works with retaining systems and temporary support measures  Preparation of drawings for preliminary, detailed design and construction phases in building construction and structural engineering, mainly formwork, reinforcement and steelwork 2D drawings  Development of models and drawings using Tekla and Allplan  Preparation of related documentation such as material lists and order lists  Close collaboration with project managers, structural engineers and other disciplines  Active communication within the project team to ensure efficient and high-quality project delivery     Must have:    Completed vocational training as a draftsperson, structural design technician or comparable technical qualification  5 years of professional experience in a similar role, ideally in structural engineering   Very good knowledge of Tekla,  preferably in 3D Concrete, Reinforcement, Steel and Wood modelling  Experience in creating reinforcement models and 2D reinforcement drawings in Tekla  Experience working on BIM projects and enthusiasm for model-based design  Good spatial awareness and precise working methods  Interest in contributing to complex and large-scale projects  Strong communication skills and ability to work effectively in interdisciplinary teams  Good spoken and written English  Independent, reliable and team-oriented personality    Good to have:    Experience working on Swiss projects  Good German language skills at B2 level or higher  Good knowledge of Allplan  Good knowledge of AutoCAD and Revit  Experience with Python and Grasshopper for Rhino    To individuals who join our team, we offer:   Employment based on an employment contract  Private medical insurance, life assurance, sport card (Multisport) and a social found    Exciting and challenging projects  Personal development opportunities  Friendly working atmosphere in a multidisciplinary and international team  Helping to shape a sustainable future   Available office locations for this position are either in  Poznań, Kraków or Łódź.  We are ﬂexible on the office location for this position, please indicate your preference in your covering letter. We value a healthy work life balance and are committed to your wellbeing. We will operate a hybrid working environment.   We are excited to receive your application,  please ensure your CV is in English .   Should you be successful you will be invited for a telephone interview followed by a 2 steps virtual or live face to face interview.     At AFRY, we engineer change in everything we do. Change happens when brave ideas come together. When we collaborate, innovate technology, and embrace challenging points of view. That’s how we're making future. We are actively looking for qualified candidates to join our inclusive and diverse teams across the globe. Join us in accelerating the transition towards a sustainable future.

5547b59f0862ba48.title: GEO, SEO & UX Senior Manager (H/F/X)
5547b59f0862ba48.jd: We are a collection of 4 exclusive Luxury brands: Sofitel, Sofitel Legend, MGallery and Emblems across 60 countries, unlocking unique experiences in connection with the local destination.  Our signature: All our Talents express themselves with authenticity, playfulness in a diverse and inclusive environment, have the ability to surprise our customers by crafting exceptional tailor-made experiences, while embracing local culture.  Join us to strive for Excellence. It is a place where you live your purpose!  Sofitel, Sofitel Legend, MGallery & Emblems are founded on a set of values that define our distinctive culture. These values unite all our talents around the achievement of common goals and principles. They define the way we interact with our guests, colleagues and communities, and guide our behavior.  Our values are:    Passion & pride:  be passionately in love with our brands, our guests and our people. Use our E.Q.   Excellence:  comprehensive business approach, driving all levers to be best-in-class hoteliers   Empowerment:  we are all Entrepreneurs, fully accountable, with strong KPIs and freedom too   Trust & Transparency:  share everything, no taboo. Feedback is a gift   Long-term relationship:  with owners as well as talent. Creating a strong sense of belonging.   Bespoke & free:  100% experience-driven. Tailored services. Unlock creativity.   Proximity:  Family spirit, responsiveness, solidarity & constant dialogue with the field      Reporting line:  the GEO, SEO & UX Senior Manager reports to the E-commerce Performance Director.   Location & working model:  Issy-les-Moulineaux (Greater Paris), hybrid working with a minimum of 2 days on site per week.   Scope:  direct ownership of 3 brand websites (Sofitel, MGallery and Emblems), plus contribution to the ALL Accor website in collaboration with our central and regional teams.   Team & partners:  no direct reports. You steer an external e-merchandising consultant, our SEO agency and our GEO pilot agency, and you work hand in hand with our internal Product & Tech and Digital Experience teams.   Your toolbox:  Adobe Experience Manager (AEM), GA4, Botify, Contentsquare, The Hotels Network.   Direct web channels represent one third of our business today, and organic search accounts for 12% of it. The rise of AI-generated answers (AI Overviews, AI assistants) and the new rules introduced by the Digital Markets Act are profoundly reshaping the way travelers discover and choose a hotel.  Your mission is to bring growth back to our organic levers - and, above all, to take Generative Engine Optimization from an agency-led pilot to an industrialized, measurable capability across our luxury brands.  Here are the main missions you will be performing:    Own the SEO strategy and performance  of our brand websites, steering our SEO agency and partnering with our internal Product & Tech and Digital Experience teams, to protect and grow organic traffic and revenue in a fast-changing search landscape.   Industrialize our Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) approach:  move from an agency-led pilot to a scalable and measurable framework - structured data, semantic markup, content hierarchy, FAQs, entity and brand visibility across AI assistants and AI-powered search experiences.   Define the content and information architecture strategy  (page structures, internal linking, content hierarchy) that makes our brands discoverable and compelling for both traditional search engines and AI-generated answers.   Define and drive the corporate e-merchandising and content strategy  across our luxury brand websites to maximize brand and commercial impact (brand understanding, customer engagement, conversion and revenue), supported by an external e-merchandising consultant.   Optimize the website architecture  (page layouts and modules) together with the Digital Experience and Product teams, by defining best-in-class and innovative UX and CRO practices, backed by A/B testing and behavioral analytics.   Monitor website performance  through regular reporting and dashboards, identifying and prioritizing the opportunities with the highest impact on organic growth and conversion.   Establish website guidelines for hotels  to leverage their hotel sections on brand websites, including but not limited to SEO/GEO guidelines.   Lead content optimization initiatives  in close collaboration with Brand, Marketing, Digital Experience, Business Intelligence, Revenue Management and Commercial teams, and external agencies.   Stay ahead of emerging trends  in AI Search, Generative AI, Search Engine Optimization, digital merchandising and user behavior to ensure our brands remain at the forefront of digital innovation.     Must-have    8-12 years of experience in SEO, Digital Performance, E-commerce, Content Strategy or Digital Merchandising.  Proven, hands-on SEO expertise (technical, content and internal linking) on large, multi-market and multi-language websites.  Solid understanding of Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) and AI-driven search ecosystems, with a clear point of view on how to scale and industrialize them.  Strong knowledge of content structuring, information architecture and technical SEO principles that improve discoverability across both search engines and AI assistants.  Experience steering external agencies and consultants and influencing Product & Tech roadmaps without hierarchical authority.  Strong analytical skills, with the ability to turn performance data into prioritized, business-oriented recommendations.  Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills in an international, matrixed environment.  Fluent in French & English, both written and spoken.    Nice-to-have    Experience in e-merchandising, website optimization and digital customer journeys on a transactional website.  Good understanding of UX principles and Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO), and of experimentation methodologies (A/B testing, behavioral analytics, continuous optimization).  Hands-on experience with Adobe Experience Manager (AEM), GA4, Botify, Contentsquare or The Hotels Network.  Experience in Luxury, Hospitality or Travel, and a strong interest in the Luxury industry.  Passion for digital innovation, Artificial Intelligence and emerging search technologies.

5a672805b9ee8a03.title: Design Manager
5a672805b9ee8a03.jd:
Join the Accor Group, an ecosystem of over 45 brands, 5,500 hotels, 10,000 restaurants, and lifestyle destinations.​ 
With us, your personality is valued, your opportunities for growth know no boundaries. Every action you take can have a positive and memorable impact on the experience of our customers, your colleagues, and also, on the planet, contributing to pioneering the art of responsible hospitality.​    Become a Heartist®, and let your heart guide you into a world where life pulses with passion.    #WeAreHeartists   To discover the life that awaits you at Accor, visit  https://careers.accor.com/    Based in  Madrid  and reporting to the  Vice President Design & Technical Services , you will play a key role in shaping the future of Accor's hotel portfolio across  Iberia, Greece, Malta, the UK, DACH, and the Nordics .  As  Design Manager , you will support the delivery of new hotel developments, renovations, and rebranding projects, ensuring every project reflects Accor's brand standards while meeting operational, technical, and commercial objectives. Working closely with multidisciplinary teams and external partners, you will contribute to every stage of the project lifecycle—from feasibility through hotel opening—helping create exceptional hospitality experiences.   What will you do?    Manage hotel design projects from feasibility through construction, pre-opening, and hotel opening.  Collaborate with owners, architects, interior designers, consultants, and project managers to ensure projects meet Accor's brand standards, operational requirements, and budget objectives.  Review architectural layouts, design concepts, technical documentation, FF&E specifications, and consultants' proposals, providing recommendations throughout each project phase.  Prepare design briefs, technical reports, meeting minutes, and project recommendations for clients and internal stakeholders.  Work closely with Development, Operations, Marketing, Technical Services, and other internal teams to ensure projects are delivered successfully.  Build strong relationships with owners and project teams, acting as a trusted advisor throughout the design and construction process.  Stay up to date with hospitality design trends, technological innovations, and Accor brand standards to continuously enhance project quality.  Travel regularly across Iberia and other European countries to attend workshops, site visits, sample room reviews, and pre-opening inspections.     We're looking for someone who:    Holds a degree in  Architecture  or  Interior Design .  Brings  8+ years of experience  in hospitality design and project management, ideally within an international hospitality company.  Has experience managing client relationships throughout the design and construction process.  Has worked across all project phases, from feasibility and concept design to construction documentation and hotel opening.  Demonstrates excellent project management and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.  Is proficient in  CAD ,  Adobe Creative Suite (InDesign) , and 2D/3D design software.  Builds strong relationships and communicates effectively with internal stakeholders, owners, consultants, and external partners.  Thrives in an international, fast-paced, and collaborative environment.  Is fluent in  English and Spanish .     What's in there for you?    Unique opportunity to develop your career with worldwide hospitality leaders.  Participation in our  All Heartists®  employee program, offering reduced rates on hotel stays and travel offers.  Package of benefits and perks of working for Accor, including discounts for hotels worldwide, and much more.  Work in a multinational and collaborative environment.  Hybrid way of working.  Talent development opportunities and access to our  Accor Academy  learning platform.  Opportunities to grow within the region or internationally across the Accor network.  Participate in ESG initiatives and contribute to our ambition to pioneer responsible hospitality.    Ready to make an impact?   If you're passionate about design, architecture, and creating inspiring hotel experiences, we'd love to hear from you.  Join us and help shape the future of Accor's Economy brands across the Mediterranean & North Africa.   Apply now.    #WeAreHeartists  
 #HospitalityIsAWorkOfHeart

fcdcfa20cdcfc07d.title: Content Manager Development and Design & Technical Services (D&TS) Europe & North Africa
fcdcfa20cdcfc07d.jd: Join the Accor Group, an ecosystem of over 5,500 hotels, 10,000 restaurants, and lifestyle destinations, in 110 countries.   As one of our 5,000+ Corporate Heartists®, come pursue your passion to the vibrant rhythm of the hospitality industry.   With us, your personality is valued, your opportunities for growth know no boundaries. Every action you take can have a positive and memorable impact on the experience of our customers, your colleagues, and also, on the planet, contributing to pioneering the art of responsible hospitality.   Become a Heartist®, and let your heart guide you into a world where life pulses with passion.       PURPOSE OF THE JOB:      The Content Manager Development and Design & Technical Services coordinates and produces content for the Development and Design & Technical Services departments for ENA PME scope. The role requires strong organisational skills, strategic vision, and a communication‑driven mindset. The Content Manager ensures all content supports the Development and D&TS business needs, aligns with the ENA communications strategy and voice, and is tailored to Accor’s diverse audiences.      MAIN COMPLEXITY / CRITICAL ISSUES IN THE JOB:    Translate Development and D&TS department business objectives into a strong communication strategy for internal and external audiences  Increase visibility for the departments and their key deliverables within ENA by implementing a clear content strategy in line with ENA Communications guidelines  Foster communications best practices and be the bridge between the Development and D&TS departments and ENA Communications department    TASKS/ MAIN ACCOUNTABILITIES:     Content Strategy Development:  Design and implement a robust content strategy that supports department internal and external business objectives   Content Creation and Repurposing:  Collaborate with the department leads and key stakeholders in preparing the key messaging and opportunities; create and oversee the production of engaging, high-quality content for each channel requirements and audience needs   Content Calendar Management : Create and maintain a content calendar for the Development and D&TS departments, including identifying opportunities and topics for amplification at a local, regional or global level; keep track of progress and ensure timely delivery of content produced and distributed   Content Management:  Review all content and ensure it is suitable and optimised for each channel specifications and audience preferences, including tone, messaging, company or legal guidelines. Ensure 360° communications audience and prioritisation mindset   Campaign Management:  Lead on key content campaign management to boost Development and D&TS visibility externally, in particular for existing and potential Partners   Content Library:  Build and maintain content library with key facts and figures related to Development and D&S ENA PME for internal and external use   Social Media C-Profiling:  Contribute to the ENA PME Social Media C-profiling strategy for respective senior leaders   Strategic Planning and Influence:  Contribute to the wider ENA Communications master planning to ensure simultaneous and aligned messaging across all channels to increase the impact and visibility for the departments   Content Collaboration and Cross-Functional Alignment:  Work closely with other content managers, communication team members or other departments, to ensure content supports broader business objectives and campaigns   Content Performance Analysis:  Monitor progress and success of campaigns and Development and D&TS communication by applying existing or new monitoring tools; provide feedback and adjust strategy where necessary     COMPETENCIES:    Creativity and ability to translate strategic thinking into action plans, content and output  Ability to identify and create core messages in line with the department and company strategy  Highly organised with ability to work in a matrixed organisation  No stranger to managing multiple projects and stakeholders with good problem-solving skills       REQUIRED SKILLS AND KNOWLEDGE:    Proficiency in English  Good writing and communication skills  Good negotiation and interpersonal skills  Prior experience of creating or managing content for various formats such as email, website, social, events, etc.    Bachelor’s Degree in communications/media/journalism/social media/marketing  3+ year experience in a communications, brand or marketing communications role

c5b0b70e0553bca2.title: Data Product Director F/M/X
c5b0b70e0553bca2.jd:
Accor Tech & Digital is the power engine of Accor technology, digital business and transformation. Our 5,000 talents are committed to deliver the best tech and digital experiences to our guests, hotels and staff across 110 countries and to shape the future of hospitality.    Accor Tech & Digital, jobs in the tech field where intelligence is above all human!      Accor Tech & Digital  is the innovation and technological transformation lab of the world leader in hospitality.  Our teams, known as Heartists®, bring together the best of hospitality with the best of tech and digital.  Our ambition is to provide our customers with personalized, memorable, and sustainable experiences.    Here,  we create new ways to travel within each of our 5,500 hotels, connecting closely with our 100 million clients in 110 countries.   Here,  we are at the heart of an incredible playground for technological transition and the design of digital products and services for our customers and hotel teams.   Here,  your scope will know no boundaries;  So join us and  dare to make an impact on the world!      Here is where your greatest challenge awaits you:      Within the  Distribution & Hotel Services Tribe  of the Data division, we are looking for a Data Product Director  to define the vision and roadmap for our data products , including, in particular, a key focus on  integrating Artificial Intelligence capabilities .   You will build a long-term working relationship with your business counterparts and all key stakeholders in the data ecosystem to ensure that the roadmap aligns with business ambitions and creates value for the Accor Group.  You will work closely with the technical lead for your scope (Data Engineering Director) to define the roadmap, in line with the strategic business and data objectives.     Your mission     :      You  define, steer and develop the product strategy and data usage , in collaboration with the Data Engineering Director for the functional area.  In particular, you work with your business contacts to  identify opportunities to leverage data  in support of strategic and operational objectives.  You will work closely with the Data Science & AI teams to  design, develop and deploy intelligent models and algorithms  within our products.  You will  draw up the roadmap  for the development and continuous improvement of products and services and act as the functional lead for this.  In partnership with the Data Engineering Director, you will work on  packaging and marketing the product offering  to your clients.  You will work in partnership with other Data Product Directors, Data Product Managers and Product Owners, as well as the Data Engineering and Data Management teams, to  ensure products are delivered on time and within budget , and to  monitor the quality  of products delivered to users.  In this context, you will  lead steering committees and communicate  on the strategy, adoption plans and product improvements for the products under your responsibility.  You  define metrics  for tracking product value and report on the achievement of objectives within your functional area.  You  manage the team  of Product Owners for whom you have managerial responsibility.       And you     ?      Graduate of a top engineering school (general engineering or IT) or holder of a Master’s degree specialising in Big Data  5 to 10 years’ experience as a Data or BI Product Manager in the development of data platforms and associated products and/or data applications  Proven experience in people management   Knowledge of database structures and data ingestion, integration and modelling processes  A strong understanding of machine learning, artificial intelligence and statistics, and their application in tangible products  Excellent interpersonal skills, strong ability to articulate ideas clearly, customer-focused mindset, and the ability to synthesise information and communicate in an accessible manner  Analytical skills, proactive in proposing solutions to resolve problems or optimise the product  Experience in the hotel distribution sector is a plus  Fluent in French and English       Accor dares to impact:       - the world      Accor is committed to the world around us, with a strong employer culture focused on the development of our 300,000 talents.   We adopt a continuous improvement approach to reduce the impact of digital on the environment across all our projects.    - your career:      We enable all our employees to manage their work-life balance and offer them the means to shape their work environment according to their preferences.   Training and career paths are defined both individually and collectively, allowing us to grow together on a daily basis.     - Specifically, at Accor Tech & Digital:    Remote work available several days per week from France, with flexible work options: work from home, from our offices, or even from our hotels and coworking spaces through Worklib.  Every Wednesday afternoon, dedicate your time to deep work and personal development.  Work in a multicultural and English-speaking environment.  Continuous improvement & training: hackathons, exceptional technology partnerships, dedicated talent management, certifications and a dedicated learning platform.    and also  ,    ALL - Heartist® Program: unforgettable stays and experiences at all Accor locations and partner venues worldwide.   Heartist® for Good Program: commit to supporting an association of your choice from those available on our volunteering platform (1 day offered per year by the Group during your working hours).   An Employee Social Committee (CSE) supporting the financing of your cultural and sports activities.   Sustainable Mobility Package for the use of eco-friendly transportation or access to a company bike program in partnership with Zenride.  Coverage of urban public transport subscriptions between home and workplace, in accordance with the rates set by French law “Loi Finance”.  €11 meal vouchers.  A mandatory health insurance plan funded at 50% by Accor without additional costs in case of enrollment of your dependents.   Attractive working conditions with collaborative workspaces, restaurants, and recreational areas as well as wellness and sports facilities, on-site or through Gymlib.    
  Your talent and motivation are our only selection criteria.     We value the richness of diverse nationalities, personalities, and professional backgrounds.    We know how to adapt to the specific needs of our employees, including those with disabilities.  
 We encourage all applications, regardless of gender,  so go ahead and apply!    Recruitment is all about people!        
 Is this mission appealing to you?  Apply, and we will offer you:    A meeting with our recruitment team to present the essential aspects of the position to you or guide you towards the role that may suit you.   An interview with the team manager responsible for the role you are interested in.    For some roles, you might also be required to complete an assessment (use case and motivation questionnaire.   A final interview with our Human Resources team to discuss our Group's culture, work environment, training program, career prospects, as well as various benefits offered by the Group.   A personalized feedback.     #accortechdigital

Entain Creative is an in-house creative agency responsible for bringing communications and marketing briefs to life, creating and producing innovative content that increases business performance across Entain brands. We deliver campaigns spanning multiple media touchpoints, including CRM, performance marketing, TV, OOH and social.  This is an exciting opportunity to join a growing in-house agency environment where you'll have the chance to influence creative standards, work on high-profile campaigns and help shape how moving image storytelling is delivered across the business.  The  Senior Motion Designer  will take a leading role in creating engaging motion graphics, animation and video content for campaigns seen by millions of customers worldwide. The  Senior Motion Designer  will combine creative thinking with technical excellence, transforming ideas into compelling content across social, CRM, performance marketing, TV and digital channels. Working closely with designers, copywriters, marketers and production partners, the  Senior Motion Designer  will help elevate the quality, consistency and effectiveness of creative output across Entain's portfolio of brands. Benefits    Generous group bonus scheme  Hybrid working - 2 days in the office  Private medical insurance  Pension Scheme - matched to 6%  Ability to buy and sell holiday  Free subscription to wellbeing app Unmind  Entain & Enhance days – 2 paid days off to focus on your professional or personal development  Sharesave Scheme   We're an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from everyone and we do not discriminate based on age, disability, gender or gender reassignment, pregnancy or maternity, race, religion or belief, sexual orientation, marriage/civil partnership, or any other basis.  At Entain, we do what's right. It's one of our core values and that's why we're taking the lead when it comes to creating a diverse, equitable and inclusive future - for our people, and the wider global sports betting and gaming sector. However you identify, our ambition is to ensure our people across the globe feel valued, respected and their individuality celebrated.  #LI-Hybrid  #LI-JO1  This is a hybrid remote/in-office role.

244962b15d5e1cb9.title: Head of Design
244962b15d5e1cb9.jd: At Entain, we don't just keep up with the pace of entertainment, we set it. Home to iconic global brands, including Ladbrokes and Coral, we're 29,000+ strong, united by a love of creating bold, boundary-pushing experiences. And when we win, we win together. Our ambition? To become the world's number one in betting, gaming, and interactive entertainment, delivering moments of pure excitement to millions, responsibly and sustainably.   Driven by continued growth and innovation across our global portfolio, this role plays a pivotal part in elevating our in-house creative agency and leading a design function at scale. It represents a unique opportunity to shape creative excellence, embed emerging technologies, and influence how customers engage with our brands worldwide.  The  Head of Design  will play a pivotal leadership role within our in-house agency, driving creative standards, innovation, and performance. The Head of Design will lead a multi-disciplinary team delivering high-impact integrated campaigns operating across all our UK based brands. The  Head of Design  will work to ensure the team operates at pace while maintaining creative integrity. The role requires strong leadership, strategic thinking, and the ability to translate insight into award-winning design across multiple touchpoints.  The Head of Design will:   Set the creative vision and act as brand guardian across all global design outputs  Lead and inspire a team of design leaders, driving high standards across static and motion  Champion AI adoption, embedding tools that enhance creative speed, insight, and quality  Deliver strategically grounded design concepts from ideation through to execution  Partner with stakeholders to elevate creative output and drive measurable business impact  Implement best practice processes to scale design delivery across multiple brands    The Head of Design will bring:   Proven experience leading large, multi-location design teams across multiple brands  A strong portfolio showcasing impactful, integrated creative work  A genuine, demonstrable curiosity about AI and its role in design, not as a gimmick, but as a tool that can unlock better, faster and more ambitious creative work  Expert knowledge of design principles, including typography, motion, and digital execution    Benefits include   Generous group bonus scheme  Hybrid working – 2 days in the office  Private medical insurance  Pension scheme – matched to 6%  Additional "It's Your Game" day off to use at either Christmas or New Year  Entain & Enhance days – 2 paid days off to focus on your professional or personal development  Share save scheme   We're an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from everyone and we do not discriminate based on age, disability, gender or gender reassignment, pregnancy or maternity, race, religion or belief, sexual orientation, marriage/civil partnership, or any other basis.  We comply with all applicable recruitment regulations and employment laws in the jurisdictions where we operate, ensuring ethical and compliant hiring practices globally.     If this sounds like a role you would be interested in knowing more about please apply with your CV and Portfolio.   Should you need any adjustments or accommodations to the recruitment process, at either application or interview, please contact us.   #LI-Hybrid  #LI-JO1  This is a hybrid remote/in-office role.

cc3e29aefd5c749d.title: Electrical Design Engineer - New Berlin, WI
cc3e29aefd5c749d.jd:
At Konecranes, we believe that great customer experience is built on the people behind the Konecranes name. Everything we do, we do with passion and drive. We believe diversity drives business success and is the foundation for our growth. We welcome different backgrounds and skills that enrich our community, and we promote a place where we can ALL be ourselves. This is what makes Konecranes a unique place to    work   .     POSITION TITLE: Project Engineer, Electrical    REPORTS TO: Lead Project Engineer, Electrical       PRINCIPAL RESPONSIBLITIES:      This position is an engineered modernizations crane control engineer responsible for all electrical design activities, hardware selection, program development, and implementation of control systems on electric overhead cranes and portal cranes for Region Americas.     · Knowledge of Product Lines – Legacy, EOT and Portal Cranes  · Engineering design, testing and commissioning of crane control systems.  · Perform engineering tasks using established procedures. These include but are not limited to component selection, schematic design, system layout, automation control programming, and system documentation.  · Generate system architecture and automation network drawings.  · Project planning, scheduling, design execution, and performance to budget from inquiry through start-up.  · Testing and troubleshooting of control systems.    EDUCATION:  Bachelor of Science in Electrical Engineering required      EXPERIENCE:  Minimum of 2 years of experience as an Electrical or Automation engineer working with motion and motor control products preferred. Experience designing and troubleshooting motor control circuits utilizing electromagnetic devices and variable frequency drives (VFD's) is essential. Specifically, a knowledge of PLC programming software is required. A qualified candidate must be proficient in reading electrical schematics and vendor application drawings      OTHER REQUIREMENTS:  Excellent understanding of electricity, motor control electrical circuits, and analog-digital input/output preferred. Must have a working knowledge of a wide variety of software packages, operating systems and control equipment. Proficiency with SAP, AutoCAD, E3 and Microsoft office. Ability to effectively communicate with frontline sales, customers, production planning (Watertown), and project management. Site visits for application and commissioning require the ability to work at heights up to 100 feet off the ground. Travel estimated at 15% to meet with customers, commission equipment, and witness product testing at our manufacturing plant.    What we offer:    Benefits:  Medical Plan, Dental, Vision, 401k plan with a match from day one, identity theft protection, accident insurance, travel insurance and so much more!      Vacation:  2 weeks of vacation per year (pro-rated for the first year depending on start date). 5-12 years of service, 3 weeks. 13+ years of service, 4 weeks.      Sick Leave:  5 days of Sick Leave per year. Pro-rated the first year after 90 days of service      Holidays:  10 paid holidays per year          Konecranes moves what matters   . Konecranes is a global leader in material handling solutions, serving a broad range of customers across multiple industries. We consistently set the industry benchmark, from everyday improvements to the breakthroughs at moments that matter most, because we know we can always find a safer, more productive and sustainable way. That's why, with 16 000+ professionals in over 50 countries, we are trusted every day to lift, handle and move what the world needs.

2b4fb509e71b877c.title: Service Designer
2b4fb509e71b877c.jd: Legal & General (L&G) is a leading UK financial services group and major global investor.    We’ve been safeguarding people’s financial futures since 1836, and strive to build a better society, while improving the lives of our customers and creating value for shareholders.    We are one of the world’s largest asset managers and provide powerful asset origination capabilities. Together, these underpin our retirement and protection solutions: we are an international player in pension risk transfer, in UK and US life insurance, and in UK workplace pensions and retirement income.   L&G Institutional Retirement looks after around 700,000 institutional customers who have their retirement benefits secured with us. Operating continuously in the UK market from our entrance in 1987, we are the UK’s longest-running insurer.   Our Institutional Retirement business is the UK’s longest-serving active bulk annuity provider.    Who we are     Institutional Retirement is the only insurer to have been operating continuously in the UK market from our entrance in 1987 to the present day. Our UK retirement annuity book stands at an estimated £86.1 billion at 31 December 2023.   Across our retail and institutional retirement businesses, we look after more than 1 million customers, around c.700,000 of whom are institutional customers who have had their retirement benefits secured with us.    We’re looking for an experienced Service Designer to help shape the end-to-end onboarding experience for our institutional retirement clients.  This is a newly created role within LGIR COO and an opportunity to establish service design in an area undergoing significant transformation. You’ll look beyond individual screens or isolated processes, joining the connections between client needs, internal operations, product and technology to create services that work coherently from beginning to end.  Onboarding will be your initial focus, but the opportunity is broader. You’ll help build practical service-design capability across the division, introduce meaningful ways to measure services and support teams to make better, evidence-led decisions.  You do not need a pensions or insurance background. What matters is credible service-design experience, sound judgement and the ability to influence across a complex organisation.     What you'll be doing:    Designing and evolving the end-to-end institutional client onboarding service  Connecting client needs with internal journeys, processes, operations and technology  Mapping service journeys, touchpoints, dependencies and areas of friction  Conducting customer research and testing services and propositions  Defining service measures and using evidence to prioritise improvements  Creating service blueprints, wireframes and prototypes to communicate ideas  Partnering with product managers and cross-functional teams to deliver change  Coaching teams in practical service-design and design-thinking approaches    Who we're looking for:    Proven experience designing complex end-to-end services  Strong knowledge of service-design and design-thinking methods  Experience connecting customer journeys with operational and technical delivery  Evidence of working effectively in a large or complex organisation  Strong stakeholder-management, communication and facilitation skills  Experience using insight, research and testing to inform decisions  Confidence helping cross-functional teams apply service-design approaches  Familiarity with accessibility standards and tools such as Figma or equivalent would be beneficial    Whatever your role, we reward performance and behaviour with a package that looks after all the things that are important to you. Here are some of the benefits we offer:    The opportunity to participate in our annual, performance -related bonus plan and valuable share schemes  Generous pension contribution  Life assurance  Healthcare Plan (permanent employees only)  At least 25 days holiday, plus public holidays, 26 days after 2 years’ service. There’s also the option to buy and sell holiday  Competitive family leave  Participate in our electric car scheme, which offers employees the option to hire a brand-new electric car through tax efficient salary sacrifice (permanent employees only)  There are many discounts we offer – both for our own products and at a range of high street stores and online  We’re creating net‑zero carbon workplaces by 2030 by investing in our sustainable, modern offices across the UK, all designed to bring people together and elevate the in‑person experience       At L&G, we believe it's possible to generate positive returns today while helping to build a better future for all.   If you join us, you’ll be part of a welcoming, inclusive culture, with opportunities to collaborate with people of diverse backgrounds, views, and experiences. Guided by leaders with integrity who care about your future and wellbeing. Empowered through initiatives which support people to develop their careers and excel.  We care passionately about outcomes rather than attendance and are therefore open to discussing all kinds of flexible working options including part-time and job shares. Although some roles have limited flexibility due to customer demand, we accommodate requests when we can.   It doesn’t matter if you don’t meet every single criterion in this advert. Instead, think about what you excel at and what else you can bring in terms of strengths, potential and connection to our purpose.

069705c3ed46c91b.title: UX Researcher
069705c3ed46c91b.jd: We’re building a centralised UX Research capability within a FTSE 250 financial services organisation — and this role is a key part of that foundation.   As a midweight UX Researcher, you’ll lead meaningful research that shapes product direction, builds shared confidence, and helps teams make better decisions earlier. You’ll be part of the Advised team while sitting within a growing central UX Research team, giving you both focus and community.   This is a hands-on role for a confident researcher who can independently plan and deliver high-quality discovery research, work closely with designers and product teams, and clearly communicate insight to influence outcomes.    What you'll do:    Lead generative and tactical discovery research end-to-end — from framing the problem through to insight and recommendations.  Select and apply appropriate research methods to meet research goals, with autonomy and confidence.  Partner closely with UX Designers on tactical discovery, supporting early exploration and shaping ideas before evaluative testing.  Conduct a mix of qualitative and quantitative research, including moderated and unmoderated studies, surveys and in-person observation at adviser firms.  Synthesise research into clear, actionable insights that teams can use immediately.  Present findings and recommendations to stakeholders, tailoring the message to different audiences.  Provide strong evidence to support decision-making, helping teams move forward with confidence.  Contribute to the development of research practices, ways of working, and tooling as the function matures.    What 'good' looks like in this role:     You can run discovery research independently and know how to adapt when things change.  You’re comfortable making methodological decisions and explaining why you’ve taken a particular approach.  Stakeholders trust your work and understand the value of research because you communicate it clearly.  Designers see you as a partner, not a handover point.   You’re confident speaking up when evidence challenges assumptions — and you do it constructively.  You help establish thoughtful, pragmatic research practices rather than over-engineering process.     What you'll bring:     Proven experience working as a UX Researcher, leading studies independently.  Strong grounding in qualitative research, with experience applying quantitative methods where appropriate.  Confidence choosing and applying research methods to answer real product questions.  Experience collaborating with designers and product teams in an agile or iterative environment.  Ability to synthesise complex findings into clear, compelling insight.  Comfortable presenting research outputs to a range of stakeholders.   Experience working in regulated environments or financial services is helpful but not essential.    How we work:    We’re establishing a research culture that values thoughtful execution — doing just enough research to make confident decisions, without slowing teams down. You’ll be encouraged to challenge norms gently, bring strong evidence to the table, and help embed research as a strategic partner rather than a gatekeeper.   You won’t be expected to line-manage in this role, but you will be expected to take ownership of your work and contribute to shaping how research shows up across the organisation.    About AJ Bell   AJ Bell is one of the UK’s fastest-growing investment platform businesses, providing award-winning solutions for everyone, from professional financial advisers to first-time investors.    Today, over 762,000 customers trust us to manage more than £121.5 billion of assets. By continually striving to make investing simpler and more accessible, we’re helping more people take control of their financial futures.    We’re proud to be recognised as one of the UK’s Best 100 Companies to Work For for six consecutive years, and a Great Place to Work® in 2025 and 2026 a reflection of our supportive and collaborative culture.    What we offer     25 days holiday, increasing with service + buy/sell scheme + bank holidays     6% Pension with matched contributions    Share schemes (including free shares and BAYE)    Health Cash Plan and discounted private healthcare    Free onsite gym    Enhanced family leave (subject to qualifying criteria)   Travel and bike loan schemes  Employee Assistance Programme      Life at AJ Bell          Regular social events including summer and Christmas parties    Learning and development opportunities tailored to you    Casual dress code    Friendly, supportive team environment      Our ways of working         We offer hybrid working, with a minimum of 50% of your working time per month spent in the office.    For new starters, there’s an initial period of full-time office working to help you settle in and build relationships.     Inclusion & diversity         We’re committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone feels respected and able to be themselves at work.    We welcome applications from all backgrounds and make hiring decisions based on skills, experience and potential.

7736112e3e924f5d.title: Organisation Design & Job Architecture Consultant
7736112e3e924f5d.jd:
Technology is our how. And people are our why. For over two decades, we have been harnessing technology to drive meaningful change. 
  
By combining world-class engineering, industry expertise and a people-centric mindset, we consult and partner with leading brands from various industries to create dynamic platforms and intelligent digital experiences that drive innovation and transform businesses. 
  
From prototype to real-world impact - be part of a global shift by doing work that matters.   The Organisation Design & Job Architecture Consultant supports the development and evolution of Endava's global job architecture and organisation design capability. 
 
Working closely with business leaders, Total Rewards and HR, the role provides expert advice on organisation design, job architecture and role design, ensuring organisational structures are scalable, consistent and aligned to business strategy. 
 
The role will also help modernise Endava's job architecture through technology and automation, supporting the development of self-service solutions that simplify job profiling, governance and organisational design. 
 
 Key Responsibilities  
 
 Organisation Design    Support organisation design initiatives across the business.  Advise leaders on organisational structures, role design and operating models.  Apply organisation design principles to improve organisational effectiveness.    
 Job Architecture    Maintain and develop Endava's global job architecture.  Support the design and governance of job families, career pathways and role profiles.  Provide guidance on job evaluation, role design and job levelling.  Partner with Total Rewards to ensure alignment with grading and reward frameworks.    
 Technology & Continuous Improvement    Support the development of technology-enabled and self-service job architecture solutions.  Work with HR Technology teams to improve processes through automation.  Identify opportunities to simplify and continuously improve job architecture and organisation design processes.    
 Stakeholder Management    Build effective relationships with HR, business leaders and key stakeholders.  Provide expert advice on organisation design and job architecture.  Support organisational change and transformation initiatives.        Essential    Experience in organisation design, job architecture or organisation effectiveness.  Knowledge of recognised job architecture methodologies (e.g. SFIA or similar).  Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.  Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.  Experience working with HR systems and organisational data.    
 Desirable    Experience supporting HR technology or automation projects.  Knowledge of Oracle HCM or similar HR platforms.  Consulting or organisational transformation experience.    
 Personal Attributes    Collaborative and relationship-focused.  Curious, innovative and committed to continuous improvement.  Strong analytical thinking with attention to detail.  Comfortable working in a fast-paced, evolving environment.  Able to influence and communicate effectively with a wide range of stakeholders.    Discover some of the global benefits that empower our people to become the best version of themselves:    Finance:  Competitive salary package, share plan, company performance bonuses, value-based recognition awards, referral bonus;      Career Development : Career coaching, global career opportunities, non-linear career paths, internal development programmes for management and technical leadership;   Learning Opportunities:  Complex projects, rotations, internal tech communities, training, certifications, coaching, online learning platforms subscriptions, pass-it-on sessions, workshops, conferences;   Work-Life Balance:  Hybrid work and flexible working hours, employee assistance programme;   Health:  Global internal wellbeing programme, access to wellbeing apps;   Community:  Global internal tech communities, hobby clubs and interest groups, inclusion and diversity programmes, events and celebrations.           At Endava, we’re committed to creating an open, inclusive, and respectful environment where everyone feels safe, valued, and empowered to be their best. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives—because we know that inclusive teams help us deliver smarter, more innovative solutions for our customers. Hiring decisions are based on merit, skills, qualifications, and potential. If you need adjustments or support during the recruitment process, please let us know.

 (This position requires working in our Warsaw Hub. Establish and manage the package delivery plan, including scope definition, discipline responsibilities, approvals, programme milestones, and interfaces.  Ensure full compliance with client requirements, ITT documentation, Discipline Lead prescriptions, and Irish statutory and regulatory obligations.  Monitor and control package scope to prevent creep, manage changes formally, and maintain cost and schedule discipline.    Innovation & Sustainability   Embed sustainability, decarbonisation, digital engineering, and innovation into the tender solution. Promote whole-life performance, resilience, and operational efficiency aligned with MetroLink objectives. Maintain design quality registers for your package and capture lessons learned. Prepare for and participate in package-level design reviews conducted by the Project Director and/or Discipline Leads.   Programme, Commercial & Risk Management   Lead your package delivery programme, ensuring all milestones and deliverables are met on time and to required quality standard. Oversee resource planning, fee management, and cost control for your package. Report monthly to the Project Director on actuals vs forecast. Lead identification, assessment, and mitigation of technical, programme, and delivery risks specific to your package. Actively manage dependency risks and inter-package coordination issues that could impact your schedule or cost. Escalate to the Project Director if they arise. Support value engineering and whole-life cost optimisation initiatives within your scope.   Technical Authority & Quality   Provide senior technical leadership for all design outputs within your package. Act as final technical authority for your package submissions, ensuring clarity, robustness, compliance with Discipline Lead prescriptions, and alignment with project objectives. Champion technical excellence within your scope while balancing performance with cost and programme constraints. Ensure all technical outputs are appropriately reviewed, verified, and approved prior to submission.   Discipline Integration & Coordination Within Your Package   Integrate and coordinate all engineering disciplines (Civil, MEP, Systems, Architecture, Specialists) within your package scope. Establish and chair regular design coordination meetings within your package. Review progress, identify conflicts, and drive coordinated solutions. Create and maintain Interface Control Documents (ICDs) for all discipline interfaces within your package (e.g., Systems-Civil, MEP-Architecture). Resolve technical conflicts between disciplines within your package. If unresolvable, escalate to the Project Director with context and recommendation. Ensure all design outputs reflect coordinated, multi-disciplinary solutions that are technically sound and compliant with Discipline Lead prescriptions.   Compliance with Discipline Lead Prescriptions   Receive and internalise all prescriptions, standards, and specifications established by Discipline Leads (Systems, MEP, Civil, Architecture, Sustainability, etc.). Ensure every design output within your package is compliant with Discipline Lead prescriptions. Adapt them intelligently to your package's context, but do not deviate without explicit Project Director approval. If a Discipline Lead requirement is unclear or cannot be met within your package context, escalate immediately to the Project Director for clarification or exception approval. Maintain traceability: document how each design decision in your package traces back to Discipline Lead prescriptions or justified exceptions.    Degree in Engineering, Architecture, Construction Management, or a related technical discipline.  Postgraduate qualification in Engineering, Business, Project Management, or similar is desirable.  Chartered Engineer or equivalent professional status preferred.  Project management certification (e.g. PMP, PRINCE2) advantageous.    Experience    Proven experience as Package Manager, Design Manager, or Senior Design Engineer on major rail or metro infrastructure projects.  Strong background in coordinating and integrating multiple engineering disciplines within a defined scope.  Demonstrated leadership of design delivery for large Design & Build or PPP projects.  Experience with complex buried metro infrastructure, including stations, tunnels, and underground facilities.  Solid understanding of MEP systems, civil engineering, and specialist systems integration.  Experience working in matrix organisations.  Familiarity with Irish or UK rail/building standards is highly desirable.    Key Competencies    Strong technical leadership and authority in a multi-disciplinary environment.  Excellent coordination, communication, and stakeholder management skills.  Commercial awareness: ability to balance quality, cost, and programme within your package scope.  Delivery-focused with ability to drive excellence and accountability.  Strong problem-solving and decision-making capability in complex technical environments.  Ability to work collaboratively within a matrix structure; respectful of Discipline Lead expertise while maintaining package ownership.     What We Offer    A collaborative, inclusive, and forward-thinking working environment.  Support from internal technical experts across all disciplines  A wide portfolio of complex and interesting projects  Opportunities for progression into a senior management role.  Ongoing support for professional development and CPD.  Flexible working arrangements and a strong focus on work-life balance.  Competitive salary and benefits package. VodafoneThree - Technical Design Authority - Subscriber Management  
 Location:  Newbury + Hybrid 
 Working Hours:   Full time 37.5 hours per week – Mon to Fri 
    *Hybrid    We believe that through collaboration and connection with our colleagues we can achieve great things. Our hybrid working approach allows our people to work both in the office and at home, providing the flexibility and resources you need to succeed in your role. We don't require you to be in on specific days; instead, we ask people to come into the office 2-3 days each week. You should work with your line manager to understand what their expectations are for you, your specific role and your team.    Who We Are    We’re here to build a network the UK can count on – one that connects people, places and potential. Because no matter where you live, what your background is, or how you get online – we think everyone deserves the same chance to stay connected, and with VodafoneThree, that future’s being built – today.   We’re creating more than the UK’s best network. We’re helping close the digital divide, empower communities and drive meaningful progress.   We believe that everyone should feel they belong. Whoever you are and whatever your story, there’s space for you here. We’re building a workplace where different perspectives are welcomed, voices are heard, and everyone feels safe to show up as themselves.   You’ll join a team that genuinely cares – about each other, about our customers, and about the future we’re building. From day one, you’ll be welcomed, valued and encouraged to bring your whole self to work.    Why VodafoneThree    Join us and you’ll be at the heart of change. That means building responsibly, investing sustainably and creating opportunities that last.   We’re not just expanding connectivity; we’re reimagining what a connected nation looks like. With £11bn invested in 5G and digital infrastructure, your work will directly power businesses, services, and communities across the country.   You’ll work on real challenges, with real impact, across every corner of the country. Wherever you join us, whatever your role, you’ll be helping to build a future that works better for everyone.   We move at pace, because what we’re building matters – and we’re learning as we go. We’re proud of the progress we’ve made, but we’re just getting started.   Join our UK Networks team, where we’re continually building and enhancing our network, connecting millions of people and businesses across the country. Be part of the team that makes it all happen – simplifying, automating, and bringing better connectivity than ever before, with giga-fast speed, to our customers.      What you’ll do    Our organisation is a leading provider in the telecommunications and digital services sector, committed to delivering high-quality connectivity and innovative solutions to consumers and businesses. With a strong focus on digital transformation and operational excellence, we aim to drive sustainable growth and superior customer experience across all touchpoints.   Technical Design Authority – Subscriber Management  is a senior technical role within the technology function, accountable for design, delivery, and optimisation of the Subscriber Data Management solutions. This role ensures that these mission-critical systems remain robust, future-ready, and aligned with the organisation’s strategic and operational goals.  The position is responsible for the end-to-end lifecycle of technology used to provide services within the domain.  Capacity management and system optimisation is a continuous priority, with the role focused on enhancing reliability, efficiency, and cost-effectiveness through performance management, analytics, and technology upgrades.   Provide technical leadership to the Design community spanning strategy to implementation and interfacing with various internal teams and external teams to ensure technology meets customer needs and also fulfils regulatory requirements.   Collaborating and helping to direct key development partners and internal teams to deliver new and enhance existing strategic systems capability.  Collaborate with partners to produce clear low/high level designs and a development plan, driving development using practical knowledge of best practices and focussing on development quality and functional capability delivery.  Drive effective partner management, ensuring delivery standards are defined, maintained and continuously improved.  Derive the appropriate test strategy and, with the QA teams, planning across VodafoneThree and Partner teams to assure successful projects/programme delivery.  Work with key technology and business stakeholders ensuring cross functional engagement and collaboration to assure successful development.  Provide active guidance to partners to support capability maturity, evolving with technology and industry trends, applying appropriate measures for continuous improvement.  Support the development of a culture of continuous improvement in the way we operate, including release and test automation, process automation and technical innovation.    Vendor Relationships –    SDM providers : Net Number , Nokia , Ericsson.    Partner Ecosystem -     Systems Integrators: Tech Mahindra, TCS, Capgemini, Sogeti.  Cloud & Hyperscalers: CNIS, NRHO , On prem Broadcom for VNF and CNF hosting     Who you are    Demonstrable experience of providing technical, decision making and problem solving leadership for a domain and can demonstrate setting quality standards for delivery and design.  Demonstrate the ability to communicate with multiple stakeholders within the organization to act as the liaison between the business, other technical communities and the 3rd party delivery teams to ensure the delivery of the business requirements. This should include the ability to convert business requirements into a technical solution.  Experience in working in an environment where you have managed delivery to a predetermined contractual/ business outcome and know how to influence/ negotiate technical outcomes with 3rd parties including conflict resolution due to changing priorities.  In depth understanding of 3G, 4G and 5G Core Network Architectures including IMS, and an understanding of the following systems: UDM, UDR, SPR, HLR/HSS, EiR, ENUM&MNP  In-depth knowledge of Diameter Network interfaces including S6a, Sh, SWx, Zh, SLh, Cx, S13 and in-depth knowledge of LDAP &HHTTP2     Worried that you don’t meet all the desired criteria exactly?       We know that everyone is unique, with multiple aspects to their identity and different experiences behind them. You can personalise our benefits for you and your family, like discounts, vouchers, a pension plan and loads more. Above all, we’re looking for authenticity and can’t wait to get to know the real you.    #VodafoneThree

d6d6cd92049399ab.title: UX & Product Design Lead
d6d6cd92049399ab.jd: About bunny.net   Some people accept the internet as it is. We see what it could be.  At bunny.net, we don’t wait for change. We make it happen. You won’t find layers of red tape or play-it-safe thinking here. You’ll find people who move quickly, take ownership, and push ideas all the way to the edge. Literally.  You’ll build things that solve actual problems, not add to them.  We’re not perfect, and we don’t pretend to be. But we’re always improving. We’re looking for people who want to do the same, who take pride in their work, and aren’t afraid to challenge what’s possible.  Because everyone deserves a better internet. And we’re here to help it hop faster.    UX & Product Design Lead   The internet runs on infrastructure. But using that infrastructure shouldn't feel... well, like infrastructure.  That's where you come in.  As our UX & Product Design Lead, you'll help shape how developers experience bunny.net.  Working closely with product managers and engineers, you'll own the UX journey from early product ideas through to polished experiences developers love using.  This isn't a role where you'll approve every mockup. You'll be hands-on where it matters most, solving meaningful product challenges while building the systems, patterns, and culture that help great UX scale across bunny.net.  You'll spend your time experimenting with new ideas, using AI to move faster, and continuously refining the experiences we build.  The best UX often goes unnoticed, because everything just works.  If that excites you, you'll feel right at home.   What will you do?     Make powerful technology feel beautifully simple    Shape the experience of products used by developers around the world    Work side by side with product managers and engineers to solve tough problems    Build the systems and design patterns that help great UX scale    Prototype, experiment, and explore with AI and modern design tools    Lead and set standards for user research and define the personas that guide every design decision    Talk to customers often, and let their feedback shape what we build    Bring clarity to complex product decisions through design workshops and reviews    Raise the bar for usability, accessibility, and thoughtful product design    Help others become better designers by sharing knowledge, giving feedback, and leading by example     What will you bring?     7+ years of experience in UX, product design, or a similar role    Experience designing cloud infrastructure, and/or products for developers    Confidence designing for technical users, especially developers    Ability to conduct qualitative and quantitative user research    A talent for turning technical complexity into intuitive experiences    Systems thinking: you know when to solve a problem once, and when to create a pattern that solves it for everyone    The ability to zoom out to strategy and dive into the details when it matters    A collaborative mindset and the ability to work closely with engineers to balance user needs with technical realities    Clear communication and the confidence to explain your thinking to anyone, from engineers to leadership    Curiosity about AI and modern tools, and a desire to keep improving how products are designed and built    An obsession with the little details that make powerful products feel fast, simple, and effortless     What will make us extra happy?     Experience building design systems, component libraries, or design tokens    Familiarity with frontend technologies like HTML, CSS, JavaScript, or Angular    Experience designing for APIs, cloud platforms, infrastructure, security, or other developer tools    Experience using AI to accelerate research, prototyping, or product design    Experience mentoring designers or helping scale design practices in a product organization      Where should you be located?    Europe, ideally within CET ±3 hours so collaboration with the team feels natural rather than scheduled.    What's in it for you?   Life at bunny.net comes with benefits that make work (and life) better.     100% flexible hours -  Your work, your rhythm. Whether you thrive at 3 am or on a beach at noon, we've got you.     Remote-first by design  - No offices, no commute, just the freedom to work anywhere. Miss the office? We’ll give you a 3-night voucher for visiting our  headquarters .     Medical, dental, and vision insurance -  Coverage worldwide.     Paid time off -  Love the slopes or the sea? Enjoy them with 25 vacation days, plus an extra loyalty day each year, capped at 5 years (30 days total), on top of your local public holidays.     Meeting-free Thursdays  - We keep Thursdays meeting free internally so you can focus on deep work without interruptions.     Home office budget -  We believe everyone is more efficient working in a comfortable office, and we're happy to help you set it up with an annual budget of €500.     Paid sick leave -  Feeling ill? Take time off to fully recover without having to worry about your finances.     Parental leave -  Paid 16 weeks for birthing parents, 8 weeks for non-birthing parents. If your country gives more, that’s your baseline. If it gives less, we top it up. Take your leave all at once or split it across the first year for maximum flexibility. After paid leave, your local statutory rules apply.     Annual fluffle building  - We're remote, but not distant! Once a year, we meet in a sunny location where virtual high-fives turn into real ones.     Employee Stock Option Plan (ESOP)  - Everyone at bunny.net gets a piece of the pie, starting with 0.01% equity.     Mental health support -  Feeling down? We've got your back. bunny.net provides mental health resources and help via   BetterHelp.com  .     Wellness budget -  An annual well-being budget of €480 is here to help you stay fresh and focused.     Educational budget -  €500 yearly for books, seminars, or online courses to keep your learning on track, work-related or not.     Music on us:  Work is better with music. Enjoy a yearly Apple, Spotify, or YouTube Premium subscription on us.

311eab6c633b1e3f.title: AI Product Sales Executive
311eab6c633b1e3f.jd: Sia is a global management and AI-focused consulting firm with a strong presence in the energy and utilities sector. With €500m in annual revenue and 3,000 employees worldwide, around 20% of our business is focused on energy and utilities.   Founded in France over 25 years ago, Sia has grown rapidly and is now a recognised leader in energy transition, data science and AI solutions. In 2024, we announced a strategic partnership with Blackstone as our first external investor, supporting our continued growth.    As an AI-first consulting firm, Sia develops AI solutions specifically designed for its clients across a wide range of industries and business functions. Sia Reg AI is one of the flagship products in Sia's fast-growing AI portfolio. Built for compliance, risk, and legal teams, it monitors regulatory changes, structures obligations, maps them to policies and controls, identifies and scores compliance gaps, and manages remediation with full source traceability.   To accelerate its commercial traction, we are hiring an AI Product Sales Executive whose single focus is to generate and convert new business. This is a hunting role: you will build your own target lists, pick up the phone, run the follow-ups, book the meetings, demo the product and close deals. You will report directly to Sia's AI Products leadership, work hand-in-hand with product and marketing on messaging and assets, and operate with real autonomy in how you run your outreach. Reg AI is your starting point, and as the catalogue grows you will extend the same motion to other AI products in the portfolio. The ideal candidate is fluent in English, resilient, target-driven, and genuinely curious about AI and the problems it solves for regulated industries.   You will also be selling AI while working with AI. Sia runs an AI-native environment: Claude is deployed across the firm and is part of how our teams research accounts, prepare calls, draft outreach and build collateral, and your commercial stack includes Amplemarket, LinkedIn Sales Navigator and HubSpot. We expect you to use all of it aggressively, and to help us make that stack sharper.   Responsibilities include but are not limited to:     Owning the new business pipeline for Reg AI in your assigned markets, from target identification and qualification through to closed deals       Running high-volume, high-quality outbound: cold calls, email sequences, social touches, and the disciplined follow-up cadence that actually converts       Delivering against clear monthly and quarterly targets on meetings booked, qualified pipeline created, and revenue signed       Leading discovery calls and product demonstrations, translating Reg AI capabilities into concrete, quantified outcomes for compliance, risk, and operations stakeholders       Owning the full sales cycle on SMB and mid-market opportunities, and teaming with AI Products leadership and Sia consulting partners on larger or more complex accounts       Getting maximum leverage out of our AI-native sales stack – Claude for account research, call preparation, outreach drafting and objection handling, Amplemarket and LinkedIn Sales Navigator for targeting and sequencing, HubSpot for pipeline management       Using the outreach toolkit, content library, and campaign assets provided by marketing, with the latitude to adapt them to your targets while staying inside Sia brand guidelines        Maintaining impeccable CRM discipline: accurate activity logging, clean pipeline, reliable forecasting, and structured weekly pipeline reviews       Feeding the field back into the product: objections, competitive intelligence, pricing signals, and feature gaps, so that positioning and roadmap sharpen over time       Extending the same commercial playbook to other Sia AI solutions as the product portfolio expands        2 to 5 years of experience in B2B sales – SDR, BDR, Business Development, or Account Executive – ideally in software, SaaS, or an AI-driven environment       Demonstrable track record of hitting or beating quota in an outbound-heavy role, with real comfort on the phone and a genuine appetite for cold outreach       Fluent in English (mandatory); a second European language such as German, French, or Dutch is a strong advantage       Resilience, self-discipline, and a hunter's mindset: you organize your own week, own your numbers, and keep going after the fifth no       Hands-on user of AI tools in your daily work – you already prompt an assistant such as Claude or ChatGPT to research, write, and prepare, and you want to work somewhere that expects it rather than tolerates it       Confident with modern sales tooling: CRM (HubSpot or Salesforce), sales engagement and sequencing platforms such as Amplemarket or Outreach, and LinkedIn Sales Navigator       Interest in AI as a product category and the ability to run a credible demo, holding your own with technically literate buyers       Excellent verbal and written communication, with the ability to make a complex product feel simple and relevant to the person in front of you       Bachelor's or Master's degree in Business, Marketing, or a related field, or equivalent hands-on commercial experience       Exposure to compliance, risk, regulatory, or financial services topics is a plus rather than a requirement      Sia is an equal opportunity employer. fb0b08af63acaaeb.title: Senior Product Designer (Growth)
fb0b08af63acaaeb.jd: About InvestEngine  InvestEngine is everything the modern investor should need. Unbeatable value, market-leading automation, and built for easy, long-term investing. We’ve built a strong foundation, have over £3 billion invested, award-winning service, and a passionate team, now we’re ready to scale.  About the Role  We are hiring a  Senior Product Designer  to join our  Growth stream  and help deliver consistently high-quality product design work at pace.  This is a hands-on IC contract role. The core expectation is simple:  deliver build-ready design with low churn . We run concept, usability and comprehension testing across the team, and you'll help plan and run studies, then turn findings and product and behavioural data into design decisions    Design in a regulated context, with a strong bias toward clarity, fair treatment and customer comprehension    What We’re Looking For     5+ years of experience designing digital products as a Product Designer or UX/UI Designer, with a strong portfolio demonstrating end-to-end ownership of complex product experiences.     Strong product design craft, spanning interaction design, systems thinking and end-to-end journey ownership    Comfortable being hands-on with research. You use product and behavioural data, along with experiment results, to frame problems, prioritise and prove that designs actually work    High ownership and autonomy, comfortable operating as a senior contractor, clarifying ambiguity and driving work forward    Excellent collaboration, working as a partner to Product and Engineering rather than a service desk    Pragmatic judgement on quality versus speed, knowing where polish matters most    Comfort working within a design system and contributing to it    Comprehension-first, fair-treatment mindset. Supportive, high-calibre team  Work alongside talented professionals who are experts in their fields — smart, driven, and generous with their knowledge.
