4b2aaf970f8706e7.title: Product Designer
4b2aaf970f8706e7.jd: Product Designer    Middlesbrough or Lisbon - Hybrid       Do you want to help shape software that affects thousands of lives?    Who are we?  We are ranked as the UK’s #1 construction specific software player and our mission is simple; to provide market leading end-to-end software solutions to the construction and construction like industries across the entire build life cycle.  If you are looking to build an exceptional career with an award-winning company you’ve come to the right place. Our teams are based in the UK, Europe, and India, working on products that are used on a global scale. We have a clear and defined road map to deliver over the next 3 years, which is centred around a large-scale digital transformation as well as continuing our growth and expansion.  We embrace diversity and equality and want our employees to be comfortable bringing their whole selves to work. We are committed to building a team with a variety of backgrounds, skills and views. Creating a culture of Equality isn’t just the right thing to do, it improves every aspect of our business.      Purpose    To deliver high-quality, user-centric product design across Causeway’s suite of products, contributing to the CausewayOne Design Language and Design System while collaborating closely with product, engineering, and business teams to bring innovative solutions to life.  The Product Designer is a core member of the Product Design team, reporting directly to the Lead Designer. This role is responsible for end-to-end design of product features — from early-stage research and ideation through to detailed UI and handoff — ensuring all output meets the standards set by Concrete, the CausewayOne Design System.       Key Responsibilities        Product Design    •  Own end-to-end design of product features across web SaaS and mobile applications, from problem definition and research through to final UI design and developer handoff.   •  Create wireframes, prototypes, and high-fidelity designs using Figma, leveraging Concrete components, tokens, and patterns to ensure consistency across all touchpoints.   •  Conduct user research, usability testing, and synthesis to inform design decisions and advocate for user needs within product teams.   •  Contribute to design crits and async Figma reviews, giving and receiving constructive feedback to maintain a high bar for design quality.   •  Collaborate with product managers and engineers to ensure design intent is accurately implemented, supporting QA at key delivery stages.   •  Create rapid prototypes to support sales, strategic storytelling, and stakeholder communication.     Design System & Tooling    •  Apply and help maintain the Concrete Design System, including components, tokens, and usage guidelines, flagging gaps or improvements to the Lead Designer.   •  Maintain well-organised, properly named Figma files that align with team conventions and the development repository structure.   •  Contribute to scalable templates and shared libraries, supporting consistency and efficiency across the design team.     Collaboration & Growth    •  Work closely with the Lead Designer, Product Director, Product Owners, and engineering teams to align design work with product strategy and delivery priorities.   •  Actively participate in 1-2-1s and performance reviews, taking ownership of personal development goals and growth within the P3 level framework.   •  Support cross-product alignment by working collaboratively across teams to ensure a consistent and cohesive user experience.   •  Explore and adopt AI tools and techniques where they can improve design quality, innovation, and productivity.       Key Skills, Experience and Qualifications        Skills & Experience    •  A strong portfolio demonstrating end-to-end product design work across web and/or mobile products, with clear evidence of user-centred design practice.   •  Proficiency in Figma, including components, auto-layout, and prototyping; experience working within or contributing to a design system is a strong advantage.   •  Solid understanding of UX principles, interaction design, and accessibility best practices.   •  Experience working in an agile product environment, collaborating with product managers and developers throughout the delivery lifecycle.   •  Good communication and presentation skills, with the ability to clearly articulate design rationale to stakeholders at varying levels.     Qualifications    •  A degree in design, human-computer interaction, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience; typically 3–5 years of experience in product or UX design.   •  Experience in or appetite to learn about the Construction and/or Infrastructure sectors, and an interest in understanding how Causeway’s products serve that market.     What you get from us:   If you're looking to build an exceptional career with an award-winning company you’ve come to the right place. We believe everyone at Causeway has a vital role to play in our success. Causeway is fuelled by curiosity and is a place for people who beam with positivity and burn with ambition.  Our team is everything, so we’ll take good care of you. In fact, we give well-being the same priority as our other business goals. We’re strong advocates of work-life balance, offering hybrid working alongside the opportunity to work from modern, collaborative offices.     Our Values   We are      United . As part of a team, we’re better together.  We are    Agile . Be the change, we’re on a journey.  We are    Trusted . Do the right thing, we own this.  We are    Driven . Get stuck in, we make it happen.    Like all responsible companies Causeway is aware of the need to recognise the importance of protecting our environment and addressing the climate emergency. Causeway is a carbon neutral company and we offset our calculated carbon footprint. However, we recognise that offsetting is not a permanent solution, so we set environmental objectives to reduce our footprint year-on-year.

58990fa1a131da03.jd: UpCloud is on a mission to be the number #1 European cloud platform, built on performance, reliability, and trust. With a strong, continually expanding portfolio of solutions and a rapidly growing international customer base, we are poised for explosive growth. We’re striving for top-notch content, and visuals are a big part of how we want to be perceived.    Your task will be to embed our brand into content that we’re creating for our future customers. This material is widely used in our online presence, events, physical booths, B2B content of all kinds, and sales enablement material at a professional level. You will fully own the creation of campaign assets for every paid and organic channel we utilize.       Produce developer-focused video content : Take charge of our visual presence on YouTube, managing video production and editing tailored specifically for our technical community.       Evolve the brand thoughtfully : Add to UpCloud’s existing brand identity and history, taking it to the next level without losing the common thread of what makes us us.       Proactively shape our visual edge : Step up with a strong "here’s how we differentiate" mindset, bringing fresh ideas to the table on how to capture attention in the cloud industry. We review all applications and get back to all our candidates - that is, a human, not an AI. That is a promise.       Benefits       Up to six weeks of annual paid vacation      Flexible and remote-friendly culture      Occupational healthcare      Travel insurance      Sports benefit      Company events and activities      Share Appreciation Rights program      Udemy E-learning platform and budget for trainings; unlimited business access      Annual company trip

f12d684b66770e34.title: UI/UX Artist
f12d684b66770e34.jd: Join us as a UI/UX Artist on Supremacy: Warhammer 40K, our strategy game set in the iconic universe!     We are looking for a talented and experienced UI/UX Artist to join our Art Team and help shape the player experience. In this role, you will combine strong visual design and UX expertise with hands-on Unity knowledge to create intuitive, polished interfaces and bring them from Figma into the final game.    You will work on a complex, systems-heavy strategy game and have the opportunity to create UI within the distinctive visual universe of Warhammer 40K, while taking ownership of UI quality throughout the full production process—early flows and mockups to in-engine implementation and visual QA.    If you’re excited about combining great UX, strong visual design, and technical UI skills, we would love to hear from you! Apply now with your CV and portfolio.      YOUR MISSION      Design and deliver cross-platform UI/UX solutions that improve usability, clarity, and player engagement.      Transform game design briefs into intuitive user flows, wireframes, mockups, and interactive prototypes.      Create visually appealing UI assets, including icons, layouts, components, and animations, while ensuring readability and consistency with the game's visual direction.      Translate Figma designs into production-ready UI in Unity, including layouts, components and prefabs, responsive behaviour, states, text, sprites, and animations.      Design and implement responsive interfaces that work reliably across supported resolutions, aspect ratios, safe areas, and device classes.      Own the visual quality of UI from initial design through in-engine implementation, including visual QA and iteration in Unity.      Analyse existing interfaces and propose improvements to functionality, information hierarchy, usability, and aesthetics.      Build and maintain reusable UI components, design systems, guidelines, and best practices across Figma and Unity.      Collaborate closely with game designers, UX, developers, tech artists, and other artists to ensure design goals are technically feasible and implementation constraints are addressed early.      Contribute to improving the Figma-to-Unity production pipeline and reducing unnecessary development overhead for routine UI implementation.      Ensure final in-game interfaces accurately reflect approved designs in terms of layout, spacing, typography, assets, responsiveness, and interaction states.        YOUR BACKSTORY      Minimum 4 years of experience in a UI/UX-related role in the mobile gaming industry or a similar field.      Strong portfolio demonstrating expertise in interface design, visual hierarchy, interaction design, and UX principles, ideally for games or other complex digital products.      Proficient in Figma, with strong knowledge of component-based design systems, variants, reusable patterns, and scalable file organization.      Strong hands-on experience with Unity UI and the ability to translate Figma designs into production-ready in-engine interfaces.      Experience working with UI layouts, prefabs or reusable components, anchors, responsive behaviour, text, sprites, UI states, and animations in Unity.      Strong understanding of the Figma-to-Unity workflow, including asset preparation, componentization, scaling, resolution and aspect-ratio handling, and implementation constraints.      Good understanding of responsive UI principles, safe areas, layout scaling, and cross-device constraints.      Experience designing information-dense interfaces and complex interaction flows; experience with strategy, simulation, MMO, or other systems-heavy games is a strong plus.      Familiarity with or enthusiasm for the Warhammer 40K universe and its distinctive visual identity is a plus.      Excellent analytical and creative problem-solving skills, with the ability to balance visual quality, usability, and technical constraints.      Strong communication skills in English, with the ability to collaborate effectively in cross-functional and multicultural teams, including remote collaboration.      Passion for staying actively involved throughout development and taking ownership of the quality of the final player-facing experience.       Why You'll Love Working With Us    A Global Team, A Shared Purpose   Our strength lies in our diversity. With over 30 nationalities represented across our two locations, we’re united by a shared passion for strategy games and a bold vision for the future. We celebrate what makes each of us unique – our perspectives, our stories, and the paths that led us here.   Work Your Way   Whether you're crafting code from a harbor-view desk in Hamburg or fine-tuning design details under the Maltese sun, we support flexible hybrid work models that empower you to do your best work – wherever you are.   Grow With Us   At Twin Harbour, your journey matters. Our  Career Path Framework  and mentorship culture provide the clarity and feedback you need to take the next step – whether you’re deepening your expertise or branching into new disciplines. We invest in your growth with language courses, e-learning platforms, and support for conferences and training.   We’re Human First   We believe that great teams are built on trust, respect, and good humor. From game nights to casual drinks, quiz nights, and karaoke, we don’t just work together – we connect, play, and support each other like a true crew.     Join Twin Harbour Interactive    Where Strategy Meets Vision.    Twin Harbour Interactive  is a global strategy game powerhouse, shaping the future of long-term multiplayer gaming. With offices in  Hamburg  and  Malta , we design strategy games that bring people together – across borders and generations.  Whether you’re an expert tactician or an imaginative world-builder, there’s a place here for you to grow, thrive, and leave your mark.

2ecfd901e4894a81.title: Senior Product Designer
2ecfd901e4894a81.jd: Simple Life  is the #1 AI-powered health coaching app for adults who want to lose weight and enjoy a healthier lifestyle—without the stress or extremes. Our mission is to empower people to feel their best every day. By challenging traditional, restrictive approaches, Simple offers a more sustainable method grounded in ease, personalization, and real-life support.  Simple has had over 17 million downloads and more than 300,000 5-star reviews, having helped millions lose weight successfully and sustainably. Simple has earned recognition as Best Virtual Coach and one of the Top 100 AI companies — all thanks to a dedicated global team driving real impact.  With SIMPLE as a partner in their pocket, users feel cared for and empowered to embrace — and stick to — new healthy habits. To learn more, visit  simple.life .    Simple is looking for a  Senior Product Designer . Your expertise will contribute to our ambitious goal of positively impacting the nutrition and quality of life for over a 1,000,000,000 people worldwide. As a  Senior Product Designer , you will focus on enhancing the customer journey through a unique behavior change methodology. Working closely with cross-functional teams, you will help shape a product that combines cutting-edge scientific approaches, AI-generated coaching, and gamification. We are building a truly innovative solution that has already proven effective for millions of users worldwide.  Key Responsibilities:     As market leaders in the AI-first approach to weight loss, we set a high standard of excellence. We are looking for a specialist who can continue to push boundaries by identifying efficient, unconventional solutions that keep us at the forefront of the industry;    Deep integration of AI technologies is a must-have — not a nice-to-have. You should be comfortable designing with AI as a core component of the user experience;    Strong understanding of gamification mechanics, user psychology, and how to effectively integrate them into product experiences is essential;    The ideal candidate goes beyond the surface. We value professionals who think critically, analyze deeply, and have a sharp understanding of user behavior and evolving market trends;    It’s not enough to follow trends — you must understand them and be confident in proposing innovative UI/UX solutions that make our weight loss product even more effective and engaging;    A deep knowledge of user habits and psychology is crucial. Our goal is to design experiences that truly resonate with users, grounded in actionable insights into what drives behavior, motivation, and long-term loyalty.     What we’re looking for:     A strong candidate has 5+ years of experience working on world-class B2C product;    Experience with Health & Fitness apps is a nice plus;    Proficient in leveraging UX research and data analytics to inform and validate design decisions;    Strong skills in modern mobile product design, with a focus on AI integration and gamification;    A data-driven mindset with a passion for rapid experimentation and iterative improvement;    Ability to generate, defend, and present original hypotheses and design solutions with confidence.     Perks & Benefits:      Remote, in-office, and hybrid work opportunities;      The equipment you need to do your job;      A premium SIMPLE subscription;      21 days annual leave, plus bank holidays (those observed where you live);      Flexible hours. We focus on your results, not how long you spend at your desk;      Competitive salary package commensurate with experience.

2d9cb6d19f9d69c2.title: Senior/Lead Economy and Engagement Designer - ARC Raiders
2d9cb6d19f9d69c2.jd: As a Senior/Lead Economy and Engagement Designer at Embark, you will be responsible for designing and implementing systems and mechanics that are deep and interesting for our players to engage with and retain them, short, medium and long term, as well as sustainable and player-friendly monetization features and models, that provide real value to our players, in a fair way.    You will join the team on ARC Raiders and collaborate closely with the directors of the project, in refining concepts and ideas into tangible designs, prototypes and features, as well as Production leadership helping in articulating and establishing estimates, project scope and timelines. You will share your insights and knowledge in shaping relevant performance indicators, as well as validation methods using telemetry data and simulations.    As a senior member of the design team we would like you to act as a coach and mentor to some of the other designers on the project, and possibly take on direct managerial responsibilities, if relevant and suitable. Inspiring and helping more junior designers with design methodology, documentation practices, etc.    You will also own and spearhead game features directly, and work hands-on in cross disciplinary teams while implementing features and tools for running a successful and smooth live service game, including community events and other types of events.     Example of responsibilities       Design, implementation and evaluation of our monetization strategy including quantitative and qualitative analysis, as well as any available automation and simulation strategies.      Understanding player motivations and how they relate to our game loops, especially in terms of delivering a fun gameplay experience with engagement systems.      Responsible for in-game virtual store including recommendations and contributions towards catalog and pricing strategy for micro-transactions.      Joint optimization with marketing, acquisition and crm teams for the entire user journey.      Be a key stakeholder in game frontend presentation and flow for engagement and game economy features.      Design and collaborate on metagame, progression and economy systems for long term player retention and engagement.      Analyze the impact of changes in the game, identify opportunities that will have a positive impact on monetization and engagement in development and post launch.      Help define key performance indicators (KPIs) related to monetization, analyze KPI reports and share information with the team and stakeholders to identify and predict trends.      Monitor trends on monetization in order to identify best practices, achieve optimal results and innovation.      We would love if you have      A creative and curious mind.      5+ years or more experience in equivalent roles.      An understanding of acquisition, retention and monetization concepts.      Understanding of AAA gameplay and game design, including player psychology, UX design, gameplay design.      Proficiency with the Unreal Engine and experience with Blueprints and scripting.      Ability to design and continuously improve the optimization process of any given game.      Experience with experimental design and/or AB Testing for data driven designs.      Experience of coaching more junior members of the team.      Strong communication skills and the ability to align cross-functional stakeholders      Professional English communication skills.       This is an on-site role, and we are only considering candidates already residing in Sweden. 6372f19280ae57d7.title: Experienced Content Designer - Victoria 3
6372f19280ae57d7.jd: Do you want to shape a century of revolutions, reforms, and societal transformation? Are you a storyteller who understands that in a grand strategy game, the best narratives emerge from systems? If you are ready to bring your craft and experience to a team that offers challenges, trust, and ownership, we want to hear from you!      Your Goal      As an Experienced Content Designer on Victoria 3, you will be a champion of the player experience with narrative in the game. Victoria 3 spans world history of the Victorian era and lets players lead any country through the most transformative century in human history. Your mission is to envision, design, write, and script narrative content that makes that world feel alive and to raise the quality bar for content across the game.           You will join a design team specializing in narrative design, technical scripting, and systems design. We research diligently and hunt everywhere for inspiration. As an experienced designer, we expect you to take ownership of larger content-focused DLCs from concept through release, and to help less experienced designers grow through reviews and mentorship.      Responsibilities        Design, write, and implement events, Journal Entries, and other narrative content in American English that fits the tone, themes, and vision of Victoria 3.        Own content-focused DLCs end-to-end: pitch ideas, prototype, implement, polish, and support your DLC after release.        Script narrative content and balance it by tuning values using our in-house scripting language.        Research 19th- and early 20th-century history for both accuracy and inspiration, and craft believable alternative history storylines grounded in that research.        Review other designers' content and writing, give constructive feedback, and mentor less experienced content designers.        Define what you need from other disciplines (art, code, QA, localization, and others) and coordinate to deliver on time and to a high-quality standard.        Raise issues early, propose improvements to our content pipeline and standards, including the use of AI tools, and inspire the people around you.        Play the game regularly to stay connected to the real player experience.        Required Qualifications        5+ years of professional experience as a content designer, narrative designer, or game designer.        Excellent command of written American English. (Please note that we will review your CV and cover letter with attention to grammar, clarity, and tone, as these are essential skills for this role.)        Familiarity with code-based scripting (reading, writing, and debugging scripts).        A deep and genuine interest in strategy games, and in Paradox Development Studio grand strategy games in particular.        Desirable Qualifications        Experience with PDS games through modding.        Experience working on a live game with a recurring expansion and update cadence.        Experience reviewing, editing, or mentoring other designers' work.        Interest in or education in history, especially the Victorian era.        Who you are      You find motivation in having the freedom and responsibility to take ownership of tasks and deliver on agreed expectations. You care about quality, and the idea of our many fans around the world praising your work after release energizes you. But you also understand the concept of “done is better than perfect” and apply it wisely. You are not afraid to raise issues, you continuously look for improvement, and you seek to inspire your teammates. At Paradox, you will be part of a result-driven, high-trust, and player-centric culture: our games and players take center stage, and our first priority is always to add player value.      Practical Information      We would like your application to include work samples and/or a link to your portfolio, if you have any. We are especially interested in shipped narrative or game content that you designed and implemented yourself.           If this description matches your background, we look forward to receiving your application!

da23d33b9c9d7287.title: Head of Production
da23d33b9c9d7287.jd: Reports to: SVP, Head of Creative Studio    Team: 20-25 direct and indirect reports    Type: Full-time, permanent    Location: London North Studios.    The Opportunity    Studio B is building the future of entertainment-led marketing.    As we continue to grow, we're looking for an exceptional Head of Production to lead one of the most important functions in our business.  You'll lead physical production while providing executive oversight across our post-production, VFX, and in-house studio operations, creating the overarching systems, processes, and leadership that enable world-class work to be delivered at scale.   This is a rare opportunity to shape how an ambitious, fast-growing creative studio operates, partnering with some of the world's biggest brands while helping build the foundations for our own original IP and long-form content.    Your Mission   Own and lead a production function that delivers exceptional work without compromising creativity, quality, or commercial performance.  You'll create an environment where brilliant people can do their best work, ensuring every project—from high-velocity social shoots to complex, VFX-heavy campaigns—is delivered on time, on budget, and to the highest standard as Studio B scales.    Where You'll Make an Impact    Production Leadership      Lead Studio B's end-to-end production function from greenlight through delivery.      Lead production kick-offs, project reviews and wrap meetings.      Act as the senior escalation point for complex production challenges, clients and talent.     Continuously improve workflows, systems, and ways of working across physical production, post, and VFX streams.     Commercial Performance      Be accountable for the commercial performance of productions - budgets, forecasts, margins and delivery - protecting margin without compromising creative ambition, and escalating risks early.     Review live-action, post-production, and VFX budgets to approve commercial decisions across the slate.    Work closely with our CFO, Production Accountant, and Post Production Manager on financial due diligence, budgeting, forecasting, and reporting across every project.     Resource Planning      Lead production capacity planning across the business, ensuring every project is properly resourced.     Forecast hiring and freelance requirements; build a deep freelance, crew, VFX specialist, and supplier network to flex around the slate.     Balance utilisation, workload and business priorities as Studio B grows.      Post-Production & Visual Effects (VFX) Oversight     Partner with and lead our existing Post Production Manager to strategically manage the in-house post and VFX pipelines (edit, grade, sound, motion design, 2D/3D VFX, finishing).    Ensure the post and VFX pipelines have the technical infrastructure, staffing, and workflows needed for high-volume and high-craft deliverables across broadcast, social, and digital platforms.    Work alongside the Post Production Manager and VFX leads/supervisors to properly scope, bid, and track complex visual effects shots and post-heavy schedules.    Maintain senior-level relationships with trusted external post houses and specialized VFX vendors for overflow or specialist requirements.     Digital & Social Production     Oversee high-velocity production pipelines for social and YouTube alongside traditional stage and broadcast workflows—managing different cost models, speeds, and crew shapes operating in parallel.    Support native post/VFX workflows tailored for volume and rapid iteration rather than single hero deliverables.    Support creator-led shoots where talent operates as the production unit, wrapping lightweight production around them.     Studio & Sound Stage Operations      Oversee the day-to-day operation of our working studio and sound stage: scheduling, crewing, kit, maintenance and utilisation.      Own health & safety compliance, insurance and risk assessment across all studio operations.      Maximise commercial utilisation of the stage - internal productions, client shoots and third-party hire.      Manage facility budgets, capital expenditure planning and supplier relationships.      Business Affairs, Compliance & Systems     Own production business affairs: talent agreements, music licensing, usage rights, VFX asset licensing, and clearances—protecting margin and managing liability.    Ensure production insurance, E&O, child performance licensing, and location/drone permitting are compliant.    Ensure GDPR and data compliance on shoots and secure handling of client assets, raw footage, and proprietary VFX media.    Own the overarching production tech stack: management tooling, media asset management (MAM), cloud rendering/VFX infrastructure, and archive strategy in partnership with post leadership.     Leadership & Team Development    You'll lead and develop Studio B's production leadership team, creating an environment where people can do the best work of their careers. This includes:      Managing and coaching a team of 7 including Production Managers, Post Production Managers and Producers.      Developing future leaders and supporting career development and succession planning.      Setting clear objectives and expectations, with regular 1:1s and performance conversations.      Building a collaborative culture of craft, accountability and calm delivery.      Championing diverse and inclusive crewing practices, including tracking and reporting crew diversity where clients require it.      Cross-Functional Leadership    You'll work closely with Creative, Client Services, newly hired Production Accountant and CFO, People & Culture, and the Leadership & Executive Team to keep productions commercially successful and creatively strong.    What Success Looks Like    Within your first 3 months you will:     Establish clear budget visibility, forecasting, and margin tracking across all live-action, post, and VFX work.    Build a seamless working rhythm with the Post Production Manager, establishing clear boundaries between operational post-management and executive strategic oversight.    Optimise parallel production models: high-craft stage, broadcast, and VFX-driven work running alongside high-velocity social pipelines.    Deliver projects consistently on time, on budget, and to standard, with margin performance actively improving.     What You'll Bring    We're looking for someone who combines deep production expertise with commercial sharpness and inspiring leadership.    Essential:     Significant senior production leadership experience within a creative studio, film/TV studio, or major production company—running production at scale.    Experience maintaining executive oversight of post-production and VFX functions, working effectively with dedicated Post Production Managers and VFX Leads.    Deep understanding of visual effects workflows, pipeline requirements, VFX bidding/costing, and how post-heavy projects integrate into broader production schedules.    Digital production fluency: experience running high-volume social/digital production alongside high-craft stage, broadcast, or VFX-heavy work.    Hands-on experience managing a physical studio facility or sound stage, including crewing, scheduling, and H&S.    Track record of leading and developing multidisciplinary teams of 20+ (live-action, post, VFX, stage ops).    Strong commercial and financial acumen: budgeting, margin protection, vendor negotiations, and slate resource management.    Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with the confidence to make decisive calls at pace.     Desirable:      Experience across both brand-funded and original/IP-led content.      Direct experience of creator-led production models where talent is the production unit.      Albert certification / sustainable production accreditation.      The Kind of Leader You Are      Calm under pressure, decisive and obsessive about delivery.      Commercially minded without losing sight of craft.      Highly organised and naturally collaborative.      Curious and always looking for better ways of working.      Passionate about developing people - a leader people want to work for: clear, fair and invested in talent.      Equally comfortable in a client meeting, an edit review or on the studio floor.      Why You'll Love Working Here    This is a rare opportunity to help shape the future of one of the UK's fastest-growing independent creative studios.    You'll have the autonomy to build, improve and lead a production function that supports world-class work for global brands, while helping bring original IP and entertainment projects to life. As Studio B grows, so will your opportunity to make a lasting impact on how we work, what we create and where we're heading.    You'll join an ambitious, collaborative team that believes in high standards, clear ownership and giving talented people the freedom to do their best work.      What You'll Gain at StudioB      Ongoing one-to-one coaching to support your performance, growth and wellbeing.        The opportunity to work directly alongside our Founder & CEO, gaining exposure to how a fast-growing creative business is built and scaled.        Real ownership and the chance to shape how our executive office operates as StudioB continues to grow.        A supportive, collaborative and high-performing team where your ideas and initiative are genuinely valued.        Career development opportunities as the business continues to expand.       Diversity & Inclusion    At Studio B, we're building a team as diverse as the audiences we create for. We welcome talented people from all backgrounds, experiences and perspectives, and we're committed to creating an environment where everyone feels valued, included and empowered to do their best work.     Before You Get Started    At StudioB, we actively use AI tools to help us work smarter and move faster, and we're excited by candidates who are curious about how technology can improve the way we work.    However, for this application we'd like to hear your own voice, ideas and experience. 8f20694d64d2e738.title: Design Director
8f20694d64d2e738.jd: About Star Stable Entertainment   Once upon a time in 2011, the founders of Star Stable Entertainment had a vision. They wanted to create a game that could make a difference. Although half of gamers are girls and women, they were under-represented in the gaming industry, both as characters and creators. We dreamed of an epic online world where tween and teen girls could share an amazing experience. And we wanted to challenge how things were done in a male-dominated industry. Fast forward to today, and our dream has come true tenfold - Star Stable Online stands as one of the most popular MMORPGs globally! At our HQ on Södermalm, our 150 employees are thrilled to continue to welcome players to the island of Jorvik, with its breathtaking scenery, beautiful horses, and magical quests. It’s wonderful to see that our dream resonates with so many players around the world, and we can’t wait to share more stories and experiences with them!   The position   We are currently looking for a Design Director to join our team. This person establishes and maintains the vision & standards for the design discipline within SSO. They are the primary point of accountability for ensuring that SSO's design team is working optimally with regard to personnel, skills, knowledge, processes, and structure.   Responsibilities      Establishing, communicating, and maintaining SSO's design vision, pillars, and standards      Collaborating with the other directors, producers, and management to ensure that appropriate design standards, processes, structure, and prioritization are in place      Managing SSO design as a discipline; ensuring that any skills or knowledge gaps are covered, and that design is provided with appropriate representation with regards to tools, pipeline, and similar improvements and prioritization      Mentoring & developing designers in player-centric design thinking; the game industry & product development best practices; cross-functional collaboration; workflows, scoping, and personal effectiveness      Assessing & ensuring the improvement / maintenance of the game's core gameplay loops, directed content, gameplay features, game systems, progression systems, and in-game economy & monetization     The position includes management responsibilities with a focus on team leadership and development        We think you      Strong empathy for our target audience & belief in our mission and values;      Established history of first-hand experience in a broad range of game design skills (systems design, interaction design, economy design, level design, quest design, core gameplay);      Leadership experience on design teams within a Live game environment;      Experience building processes, structure, and communication in support of cross-functional teams;      The ability to motivate, inspire, and challenge team members;      Clear understanding of a range of business models across varying game genres      Exceptional communication skills      Perks for joining us?     A pretty sweet mission. We are developing the world's best horse-riding game for girls and we take that vision very seriously. We strive to hit that mark every single day.    30 vacation days (+ 3 additional squeeze days).    A pension and insurance plan that mimics ITP1 and a parental pay top-up @90%.    Health allowance at 5000 SEK per year.    Hybrid working model - combine WFH and being together with the team at our new office located right amidst Södermalm GameDev cluster (Magnus Ladulåsgatan 65)    Fitness discount of 18% at SATS gym + company workout classes.    A dog friendly office! Bring your furry friend to work!    Are you ready to be a chapter on this magical journey? Apply now! We can’t wait to hear your story!

The Role  
 Help us build the operating system for human longevity. 
 Virtusan is a Swiss-based longevity ecosystem at the intersection of science, technology, and premium real-world experiences. We connect data, behaviour, and environments so people can live longer, better lives. We're a small team and offer real ownership from day one. 
 We need someone who owns their work completely: defines the experience, conducts the research, designs the flows, and iterates without waiting to be asked. 
 This is not just an execution role. You will shape how our app is used, how it guides people through their health data, and whether it actually changes how they live. You will be accountable for outcomes, not just outputs. The measure of your work is whether users build real habits, understand their biology, and come back because the product earns it. 
 Tasks 
  What You'll Own  
  Product concept and experience design  
 
 Originate new product concepts from scratch, not just improve what exists 
 Design complete user journeys that translate complex biometric data into clear, motivating daily guidance 
 Ensure every flow serves behaviour change, not just usability: ask why a feature exists and what it helps the user to accomplish, not just how it should work 
 Hold the line on experience quality across the full app 
 
  User research  
 
 Plan and run your own user research: interviews, usability tests, diary studies, and in-app feedback loops 
 Turn qualitative and quantitative signals into actionable design decisions 
 Build and maintain a clear picture of who our users are, what motivates them, and where we lose them 
 Bring user evidence into every design conversation 
 
  Design execution  
 
 Build and evolve our next app version with fast protoptyping in Figma or Claude Design moving fast without sacrificing foundamentals 
 Design for the constraints of mobile: clarity, performance, and one-handed use 
 Maintain our design library and high-fidelity mock ups. Ensure consistency across components, patterns, and interaction models 
 Collaborate closely with product and engineering to ship what you design 
 
  Iteration and quality  
 
 Define success metrics for your work and track them 
 Test your assumptions before and after launch 
 Spot what isn't working and fix it, with or without a brief 
 
 Requirements 
 
 6 to 7 years of experience as a product or UX designer, with a portfolio that shows end-to-end ownership 
 Proven ability to originate product concepts, not just refine existing ones 
 Deep mobile app design experience: you understand iOS patterns, constraints, and work with a small screen 
 Strong user research skills: you design the study, run it, synthesise it, and act on it 
 Expert-level Figma skills and a clean, efficient design process. Experience with AI tools to accelerate the whole design process. 
 Fast prototyping and concept validation: you build lightweight, testable prototypes early to prove or disprove an idea before committing to full design. You iterate quickly on evidence and know when something is ready to build and when it isn't 
 Able to design for behaviour change: you understand how habits form and how design can support or undermine them 
 Strong written English: your product design copy is natural and is an integral part of your designed flows 
 Takes ownership: makes well-reasoned calls independently rather than waiting for direction 
 Based geographically in EU/UK timezone. Applications from Asia or the Americas will not be considered. 
 
  The following are strong advantages:  
 
 Experience in health, wellness, or longevity products 
 Experience building data products & data visualisations 
 B2C product experience 
 Fluency in German 
 
  Send a resume with a portfolio link or attachment showing work you have led: original concepts, user research, full journeys, shipped mobile experiences.

About Co-Star 
 Someone downloads Co–Star every 5 seconds.  
 In the five years since we launched, 25% of young people 18-25 in the US have downloaded the app.  Big Sean  has rapped about us, Ariana Grande &  Kevin Durant  post screenshots to their IGs, and we’ve been  App of the Day  twice. We’ve been featured in the New York Times three times, this year on the cover of  NYT Style . We have a global following, in 193 countries – missing just North Korea and Eritrea.  
 We don't pay for marketing – we designed the app to go viral, and it did.  
 Astrology has been popular for 4,000 years. 
 Astrology is a tool for speaking about yourself, about who you are, what you’re experiencing, and how you relate to other people – in other words, a language for the things that really matter. It’s a structured system, based on the physical locations of the planets in the sky, developed over millennia 4,000 years of practice.  
 Everyone has memories of reading a horoscope in the newspaper. You know your sign the same way you know the name of the street you grew up on.  An average of 43% of Americans have believed in astrology since the 1970s.   
 We’re merging the resonance of the humanities with the precision of technology.  
 Co-Star uses real-time NASA data and AI to bring this practice to the modern age. Every day, Co–Star generates millions of hyper-personalized horoscopes – a scale never previously possible. Every word of it is based on each person’s unique astrology: where the stars physically were when they were born and where those same stars are now. Co–Star combines the art of ancient practice with cutting-edge artificial intelligence, creating the first synthetic text to be called “wildly beautiful.” 
 We’re a small, experienced team.  
 Co-Star is a team of 30, with experience in big tech (Amazon, Google, Snapchat), entertainment (Frank Ocean, Adult Swim), and academia (Harvard, Stanford, NYU, Columbia).  
 About the brand designer role 
 We're looking for a talented visual designer to shape how Co-Star shows up outside of the app, in the broader world. We are looking for someone with a fresh, opinionated, and high-quality design foundation who can create work that feels distinct, not what’s now but what’s next.  
 You'll partner closely with the leadership on campaigns and visual storytelling across earned and owned channels. This is a freelance engagement with potential for a long-term partnership as the work (and team) grows. 
 What you'll do 
 
 Design campaign visuals: ads, social, launches — from concept through finished assets 
 Bring editorial design sensibility to our owned channels: email/welcome series, blog, campaign imagery 
 Develop visual systems that are expressive rather than corporate 
 Partner with marketing on what earned and owned should look and feel like

 You're a senior IC — roughly 5–8 years in — with a portfolio of expressive, culturally fluent graphic design: editorial, campaigns, identities across print and digital 
 Typography and composition are your first language 
 You can direct as well as execute: you've shaped campaigns, not just produced assets for them 
 You're plugged into visual culture across art, fashion, publishing, music, and the internet 
 You work well remotely and independently 
 
 Nice to have 
 
 Editorial/publication experience (print or digital magazines) 
 Motion or illustration 
 You already make things with generative tools

 Freelance/contract, part-time to start, with room to grow 
 Fully remote, anywhere. No travel required (though you're always welcome in NYC)  
 
 To apply 
 Send your portfolio. We care about taste, range, and point of view.

 Collaborate within a strong design team through reviews, critiques, shared patterns, and design system contributions.

 6+ years of experience as a Product Designer working on digital products. 
 Strong product thinking and the ability to approach design through connected user scenarios, product goals, and system constraints.

 Ability to balance usability, consistency, technical feasibility, and innovation in complex systems.

bc98e0c1e9bd3c49.title: Senior Product Designer, Securities
bc98e0c1e9bd3c49.jd:
Who we are   
 We simplify wealth creation. Founded in 2014 in Vienna, Austria by Eric Demuth, Paul Klanschek and Christian Trummer, we’re here to help people trust themselves enough to build their financial freedom — for now and the future. Our user-friendly, trade-everything platform empowers both first-time investors and seasoned experts to invest in the cryptocurrencies, crypto indices, stocks*, precious metals and commodities* they want — with any sized budget, 24/7. Our global team works across different cultures and time zones, bringing our products to more than 7 million customers, making us one of Europe’s safest and most secure platforms that powers modern investing. 
   
 Headquartered in Austria but operating across Europe, our products are built by fast-moving, talented, “roll-up-your-sleeves-and-make-it-happen” kind of people. It’s these diverse perspectives and innovative minds operating as ONE TEAM that keep Bitpanda at the cutting edge of our industry. So if you’re someone who thinks big, moves fast and wants to make an impact right from day one, then get ready to join our industry-changing team. Let’s go! 
      The Mission  
 We are on a mission to democratize finance for over 7 million users. As our Senior Product Designer for Securities & Commodities, your mandate is to take the high-stakes, data-heavy complexity of equities, derivatives, commodities, and real-world assets (RWAs) and architect them into seamless, intuitive user journeys. In our collaborative, "no-silo" culture, this role tackles the heavy lifting of investment products at scale—partnering directly with Product, Engineering, Data and Compliance to drive real-time impact on conversion, retention, and user trust without sacrificing functionality. 
  What You Will Do  
 
 The core of this role involves designing end-to-end trading and investment interfaces for TradFi and RWA products across mobile and web platforms, with the clear goal of increasing customer engagement and monetization. 
 Dense financial mechanics—including margin trading, commodities trading, and automated recurring investments—must be translated into accessible, low-friction journeys that educate and empower both novice and experienced investors. 
 Comprehensive user research, usability testing, and behavioral analysis will serve as your primary tools to diagnose funnel bottlenecks, validate product hypotheses, and continuously improve KPIs like trading conversion and drop-off rates. 
 Active contributions to our scalable design architecture are expected, applying the highest UX standards to ensure high-quality, consistent touchpoints across all investment areas. 
 Seamless partnership with Product, Engineering, Risk, and Legal teams in a fast-moving, regulated environment is critical to shape the product roadmap, validate customer problems, and ensure feasible, compliant feature implementations. 
 
  Who You Are  
 
 A strong background in Product/UX/UI Design is required, featuring mandatory experience designing for complex fintech, brokerage, trading, or wealth management ecosystems. 
 Exceptional proficiency in Figma, rapid prototyping, and interaction design is essential, alongside a proven ability to untangle data-heavy interfaces and intricate workflows into clean, elegant systems. 
 Behavioral analytics, A/B testing, and funnel metrics should naturally drive your design decisions to proactively identify opportunities that boost customer engagement, adoption, and retention. 
 A proven track record of thriving in fast-moving, highly regulated environments will demonstrate your ability to successfully negotiate solutions that satisfy strict Risk and Compliance requirements without compromising the end-user experience. 
 High customer empathy and excellent stakeholder management skills are necessary to build long-term user trust while championing a product-driven, highly collaborative culture across the organization. 
    What’s in it for you  
 
  Flexibility to work where you thrive  – Enjoy the freedom of our Hybrid working model, combining onsite collaboration and remote work, with an additional 25 days per year to work from a city or country of your choice. 
  Reward for your impact  – Receive a competitive total compensation package aligned with Bitpanda’s pay-for-impact policy, including participation in our stock option plan. 
  Support for your mental wellbeing  – Access confidential coaching, counselling, and mental health resources whenever you need them through OpenUP. 
  Time to recharge  – On top of your standard annual leave, prioritise your wellbeing in 2027 with 3 additional days of paid time off to rest, reset, and recharge, available once you’ve been with us for 6 months. 
  Continuous learning and growth  – Grow your skills and stay ahead in your career with unlimited access to Udemy’s library of online courses at your own pace. 
  Exclusive perks and rewards  – Enjoy discounts, rewards, and perks from partners worldwide across lifestyle, wellness, tech, and travel. 
  Support during life milestones  – Take advantage of up to 8 additional weeks of gender-neutral new parent leave to welcome and bond with your new addition to the family. 
  Fuel and focus on-site  – Pandas in Vienna, Bucharest, Barcelona, and Berlin can enjoy free onsite dining, with freshly prepared lunches and snacks to keep you fueled and focused all day long. 
  Recognition for your contributions  – Celebrate milestones and achievements with recognition and rewards for your Tenure at Bitpanda. 
  Show your Bitpanda pride  – Access exclusive Bitpanda-branded merchandise and gear to represent. 
  Connect and celebrate with your team  – Join unforgettable company events, from our Winter Party in Vienna to gatherings worldwide, fostering fun, connection, and celebration 
 
        .…and even more location-specific benefits designed to make life at Bitpanda even more rewarding wherever you are. 
   
 Above all, you will have the opportunity to learn and grow as part of Bitpanda’s incredible journey towards being Europe’s future #1 investment platform. 
  Bitpanda is committed to fostering a fair and equal environment based on trust and mutual respect. We believe that a diverse and inclusive workplace is paramount to our success and we are committed to building a team that represents a wide variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills.  
   * These benefits may be adjusted at Bitpanda’s discretion and do not apply to our internships and exceptions to our Hybrid Working policy apply to teams with shift schedules or for folks whose roles require them to be in-office (think: Workplaces team or IT).

We’re building a place where people can take ownership, solve problems that matter and do work they’re proud to stand behind. If you want to do your best work alongside people who care as much as you do, you’ll feel at home here.

 About the Role 
 As a Senior Product Designer at Fluxon, you'll lead design end-to-end on ambitious projects, often working directly with founders and product leads to shape what gets built. We are looking for design generalists, someone who owns the design surface, thrives in ambiguity, and cares as much about why something gets built as how it ships.

 Partner with founders, product leads, and other stakeholders to turn business goals into experiences customers love

 Qualifications 
 
 Experience leading product design end-to-end, from strategy through to production ready execution, delivering work that customers love and drives business results

 Strong visual craft across layout, typography, iconography, color, and motion, with the ability to take work to a polished, production ready bar 
 Excellent communication and presentation skills across written, visual, and spoken formats, with experience presenting directly to clients 
 Comfortable collaborating closely with clients, PMs, and engineers, including managing expectations, navigating disagreement, and keeping the work aligned 
 Experience shipping with startups or founding teams, comfortable building from zero without established design foundations or process 
 Experience working with US clients (European clients a plus)

 Competitive salary

 Flexible paid time off 
 Profit-sharing program 
 Healthcare 
 Parental leave, including adoption and fostering 
 Gym membership and tuition reimbursement 
 Hands-on career development

You will join a team redefining how products are conceived, designed, and built — leveraging AI to accelerate insight, decision-making, and execution. This role sits at the intersection of enterprise UX, AI-enabled workflows, systems thinking, and business outcomes. You will help define how intelligent capabilities are surfaced inside complex operational workflows while also evolving how UX itself is practiced in an AI-centered product development lifecycle. You will work closely with Product Management, Engineering, Architecture, Data/AI teams, and executive stakeholders to design scalable, trustworthy, and high-impact experiences for some of the world's most complex supply chain environments.  
 What You Will Be Doing 
 
 Partner with Product Management and Architecture to define experience strategy across key platform areas — shaping not just what we build, but how intelligent, AI-driven capabilities are surfaced and experienced.

 5+ years designing complex, data-rich enterprise applications, with a track record of simplifying challenging workflows into intuitive, high-impact experiences.

 Portfolio demonstrating end-to-end product thinking — from problem framing and user insight through to shipped outcomes.

1f860d587c722671.title: Product Builder, AI-Native
1f860d587c722671.jd:
Hi there! 👋  
 I’m   Joonas,   CEO & Founder of MeetingPackage. I’m building a small, world-class team of builders, people who move fast, own everything they build, and are genuinely obsessed with what’s happening at the frontier of AI. This Product Builder role is part of that team. 
 This isn’t a role where you shadow people and wait for tasks. You’ll work and report directly to the CEO and be expected to build real things from day one. You’ll have full ownership of what you ship. No committee approvals. No waiting in line. If you already reach for AI before anything else, not as a shortcut, but as the default way you think and build, and you’re frustrated that most companies are still figuring out what a prompt is, you’ll feel right at home here. Read about our journey   here  . 
 This is a full-time role that can start between August and September. You’ll have the flexibility to work remotely from anywhere in Finland. If you prefer a hybrid model, you can combine remote work with on-site collaboration at our lovely office in Espoo.  🌍 
  What you’ll actually do  
 Have end-to-end ownership of your work. That means you identify a problem, propose a solution, build it, and put it in front of real users. The job isn’t to “build AI agents,”  the job is to build great products, and AI is simply how you do it. It’s native to how you think, not a feature you bolt on. You’ll build both outward and inward. That means customer-facing product features that hotels and venues interact with every day and internal tools that make our own team faster from the moment they’re shipped. No backlog item waiting six months to matter. If it solves a real problem, it goes live.  🚀 
 
 Ship product that solves real problems for hotels and venues globally, using whatever combination of AI, automation, and code gets the job done best 
 Build internal tools that our team actually uses: automations, dashboards, workflow shortcuts that save hours every week 
 Go from idea to working prototype in hours or days, not weeks 
 Stay genuinely ahead, and you’re already testing new models and tools before they’re mainstream, and you bring that into everything you build 
 Own the full cycle: build, ship, observe, iterate for both internal and external audiences 
 Work directly with the CEO, no layers, no 1-on-1 rituals, just outcomes 
 Contribute to architectural decisions on our new AI-native platform while also shaping the foundation that already runs the industry 
 
  You'll feel at home if you  
 
 Use AI natively; it’s not a feature of how you work; it’s the foundation. Claude, Cursor, Lovable, Gemini, whatever came out last week 
 Have actually shipped something with AI at the core as a side project, a weekend build, a tool you made for yourself because nothing else existed 
 Can work independently and make decisions without needing someone to validate every step 
 Move fast and don’t treat uncertainty as a blocker 
 Have a basic understanding of software fundamentals (or you learn them as you go, because you already do that) 
 Are excited to be part of a small, focused team, not a big company process 
 Can start between August and September 
 Are based in Finland with a valid work permit 
 
  Why now is a great time to join?  
 
 You’ll be well taken care of: We offer a 3000 € monthly salary, a stock options package, occupational healthcare (Heltti), tools and equipment of your choice, support for your remote office, whether you prefer to work fully remotely anywhere in Finland or from our Espoo office, and a weekly 1-hour workout break. 
 We’re building momentum:  This is a chance to join at a stage where your impact truly matters, with direct access to the CEO and real decision-making, not layers of hierarchy. 
 You’re joining a team, not just a company: We work closely together, celebrate wins, and continuously brainstorm and innovate. You don’t just manage tasks, you help set the agenda. 
 The industry is changing: You’ll be working on a platform already used by 12,000+ venues across 100+ countries, with plenty of room to shape what comes next. 
 
  How to apply  
 We want to hear your story. What have you built? Started a company and failed? That doesn’t matter. What matters is that you’re constantly learning, constantly shipping, and genuinely curious about what’s next. You’re a true builder, and that shows up in how you talk about the things you’ve made. 
 Apply in English and include at least one of the following: 
 
 A GitHub profile or repo that shows you building something 
 A project, demo, or write-up where you’ve used AI agents or LLMs to build something real 
 Anything else that shows how you think and what you’ve made 
 
 Don’t wait too long; we’ll be reviewing candidates as we go. 
  Our hiring process:  
 
 Application review (remember to follow the "how to apply" instructions ⬆️) 
 Recruiter Screening with our Head of People 
 Interview with our CEO 
 On-site interview with the Builder team 
 Offer 🎉 
 
  About MeetingPackage   
 We are a software company that allows hotels and event venues to sell, operate, and manage their Meetings & Events spaces. MeetingPackage improves the Meetings & Events booking process for meeting planners and event venues. We integrate with venues’ existing property management, sales & catering, and back-office solutions while delivering products to all customer-facing channels. Products include Venue & Sales Management Software, an online Booking Engine, and a Meetings & Events–specific Channel Manager. 🚀 
 We’re a diverse team of 50+ professionals from 20+ nationalities. We value transparency, communicating with trust and honesty, and ownership, embracing an "I'll figure it out" attitude. Teamwork is essential—we learn from and support one another, always striving to win as one. Our ambition drives us to think big, tackle challenges, and continuously improve. And through it all, we never forget the importance of laughter—taking our work seriously but not ourselves, staying friendly, open, and always ready for a good laugh. We come together regularly e.g. organising kick-off events—most recently in Spain in January 2026.

f347d21a70560f05.jd:
About Momence  
  Momence  was founded in 2020, graduated from Y Combinator, and raised an $11M Series A. We build and operate a software platform for experience-based and membership-driven businesses, including yoga and fitness studios, dance schools, wellness centers, salons, golf facilities, and more. Today, Momence supports more than 5,500 businesses and hundreds of thousands of end users every month. From day one, you'll work on a product with real impact, helping businesses grow, streamline operations, and create better customer experiences. 
 Since 2025, Momence has been part of Xplor Technologies, a global technology company providing software, payments, and commerce solutions for service-based and membership businesses worldwide. This allows us to combine the speed, ownership, and product mindset of a startup with the scale, stability, and opportunities of a global organization. 
  About the role  
   As a   UX/UI   Designer, you play a pivotal role in creating intuitive and visually appealing user experiences for our digital products. You collaborate closely with cross-functional teams, including product managers, developers, and stakeholders, to understand user needs and translate them into engaging and user-friendly interfaces. You have a passion for user-centered design, a strong understanding of user research methodologies, and   proficiency   in design tools.      
   Key Areas of Responsibility:      
 
   Collaboration and Communication:  Work closely with cross-functional teams, including product managers, developers, and stakeholders, to understand project requirements and align design solutions with business goals. Effectively communicate design concepts and rationale to gain buy-in and feedback. Collaborate with developers to ensure the successful implementation of design solutions, providing support and clarification throughout the development process.     
 
 
   User Research and Analysis:  Conduct user research to understand user needs, behaviors, and pain points. Analyze data and insights to inform design decisions and ensure user-centered design solutions.     
 
 
   User Experience Design:  Create wireframes, prototypes, and interaction flows to conceptualize and design intuitive user experiences. Collaborate with stakeholders to gather feedback and iterate on designs based on user feedback and usability testing.     
 
 
   User Interface Design:  Develop visually appealing and consistent user interfaces that align with brand guidelines. Apply design principles to create visually compelling layouts, graphics, and iconography.     
 
 
   Information Architecture:  Structure and organize information effectively to ensure a seamless and intuitive user experience. Create user flows, sitemaps, and navigation systems to optimize user interactions.     
 
 
   Design System and Guidelines:  Contribute to the development and maintenance of design systems and guidelines to ensure consistency across products and promote efficient design processes.     
 
 
   Industry and Design Trends:  Stay updated with industry trends, emerging technologies, and design best practices. Apply this knowledge to drive innovation and elevate the overall user experience.     
 
   
  What are we looking for?  
 
 3 years of experience in UX/UI design or product design. 
  Bachelor's degree in Graphic Design, Interaction Design, Human-Computer Interaction, or a related field (or equivalent work experience).     
  Experience as a UX/UI Designer or in a similar role.     
  Strong portfolio showcasing a range of UX/UI design projects and a solid understanding of design principles.     
  Proficiency in design tools such as Sketch, Figma, or similar.     
  Knowledge of HTML, CSS, and front-end development principles to effectively collaborate with developers.      
  Knowledge of interaction design, information architecture, and visual design principles.     
  Experience conducting user research, usability testing, and applying user-centered design methodologies.     
  Strong problem-solving skills, with the ability to analyze design challenges and propose innovative solutions.     
  Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to effectively present and articulate design concepts and decisions.     
  Experience working in Agile development processes and collaborating with development teams.     
  Attention to detail and a strong focus on delivering high-quality designs that enhance user experiences.     
  Up-to-date knowledge of industry trends, emerging technologies, and best practices in UX/UI design.     
 Fluency in English, as we use it daily. 
 Based in the Czech Republic. You can work from our Prague office, fully remotely, or in a hybrid setup—whatever works best for you. 
 
   
  What can you expect from us?  
 
 Work on diverse UX projects, designing web interfaces, checkout flows, and key platform components. 
 Competitive salary, with the option to be paid in CZK or USD. 
 A modern office in Prague’s Karlín district 
 Remote or Hybrid 
 Regular team events. 
 A friendly and supportive environment, fostering collaboration and professional growth. 
 
 Through the recruitment process you’ll be guided by  Dasa Slovik Michalkova  (Global Talent Acquisition Specialist | People & Culture). 
  At Momence, we celebrate diversity and strive to create an inclusive environment where there is respect, regardless of your background or identity. We are committed to being an equal opportunity employer and welcome you as you are.

FlySto is a startup project with a small, distributed team. We have a server, web client, and Android and iOS apps – all written in Kotlin and supported by JetBrains.  
 Modern aircraft, even small ones, are equipped with sophisticated avionics systems that measure various flight and engine parameters and record them to internal storage or memory cards. The resulting log files contain enough data to literally “replay” an entire flight, displaying the aircraft’s precise position and orientation, along with all instrument readings available to the pilots. Our product allows pilots to store and analyze their flights from different perspectives on the web and mobile devices.  
 We are currently looking for a Lead Product Designer to join our team! 
  In this role, you will:   
 
 Guide a small team of product designers, ensuring team productivity and high-quality results. 
 Own the design direction and lead large-scale initiatives from vision and strategy through execution. 
 Take ownership of the design process hands-on – from research and problem framing to creating wireframes, mockups, and prototypes, as well as delivering a polished UI. 
 Collaborate with product managers, developers, researchers, and stakeholders to define problems, align on goals, and ensure design solutions meet user and business needs. 
 Effectively communicate design concepts and decisions to stakeholders and the team to promote alignment and understanding. 
 Conduct and analyze usability testing and user research to create design solutions based on real user needs and behavioral data.   
 
  We will be happy to have you on our team if you:   
 
 Are proficient in Figma. 
 Can apply an existing brand’s visual language consistently within product interfaces. 
 Are able to clearly articulate design decisions, explain thought processes, identify issues, and justify proposed solutions. 
 Have a realistic understanding of your strengths and areas for growth. 
 Can participate actively in product discussions and cross-functional collaboration. 
 Are able to guide tasks end to end, from design solution through implementation and user feedback. 
 Feel comfortable working in a highly iterative environment and adapting solutions as the product evolves.  
 
  We would be especially thrilled if you:   
 
 Have experience designing mobile applications. 
 Are interested in aviation, or even a pilot!

You understand that good legal counsel doesn’t just mitigate risk. It also fosters innovation. Comfortable navigating the gray areas of new technology, you enjoy finding pragmatic paths forward and building frameworks that help teams move faster. 
  About JetBrains  
 We create intelligent software development tools for developers and teams. More than 15 million users, over 300,000 companies, and 88 of the Fortune Global Top 100 rely on our products to solve real, complex problems. Our mission is simple: make development teams more productive and AI adoptable at scale. 
  What you’ll do  
 As we expand our AI initiatives and explore new commercial models, the legal landscape in which we operate is becoming more complex.  We are looking for a Senior Legal Counsel to join the Product and Business Development legal team.  This role isn't about saying "no"; it's about figuring out "how." You’ll shape scalable legal frameworks that support product innovation, strategic partnerships, and sustainable growth. 
 You’ll work closely with the Product, Go-to-Market, Business Development, Marketplace, and University Relations teams, helping them understand and navigate regulatory realities while keeping the focus on user value.  You’ll own the legal life cycle of new offerings and partnerships, collaborating with a team of experienced lawyers to solve problems no one has solved before.  
 Day to day, you will: 
 
 Advise on the entire life cycle of software products, services, plugins, and AI features - from refining early concepts to retiring older features. 
 Implement legal and regulatory requirements, including AI regulation and consumer protection. 
 Draft, negotiate, and advise on strategic tech, AI partnership, and collaboration agreements. 
 Support JetBrains Marketplace initiatives and relationships with third-party platforms. 
 Guide the legal aspects of our educational, academic, and research initiatives. 
 Improve legal operations by designing templates, playbooks, and self-service resources that reduce the need for manual legal review. 
 Equip the sales and procurement legal teams with product expertise to help them negotiate customer and vendor agreements. 
 Share knowledge and insights across the legal team and broader business to build awareness around best practices. 
 
  What you’ll bring  
 
 A pragmatic approach to problem-solving, balancing legal risk with business realities. 
 The ability to explain complex legal concepts clearly and simply to non-lawyers. 
 A strong ownership mentality, seeing matters through from start to finish. 
 Comfort making decisions in ambiguous environments, especially regarding novel technologies like AI. 
 A collaborative mindset, working well with stakeholders across different teams and disciplines. 
 A continuous drive to improve workflows, automating or standardizing routine tasks where possible. 
 Transparency, integrity, and the willingness to speak up when something doesn’t make sense. 
 
  What you’ll need  
 
 A formal degree in law (LLB, LLM, Mgr, or equivalent). 
 An extensive background advising multinational corporations on technology and commercial law. 
 A proven track record of successfully drafting and negotiating sophisticated commercial and technology agreements. 
 A deep understanding of software products, digital services, and technology business models. 
 Fluency in English and the ability to negotiate and draft complex legal documents clearly and effectively. 
 The demonstrated ability to manage multiple complex tasks and stakeholder relationships simultaneously. 
 
  What success looks like  
 Success means you’ll have become a trusted advisor to our product and business teams. You don’t just review contracts. You are actively involved in the strategy, ensuring legal frameworks are an enabler of growth rather than a bottleneck. Over time, you will have established clear, scalable self-service resources that allow teams to handle routine legal questions independently, freeing you up to focus on high-impact, complex challenges. You’ll leave things cleaner and more efficient than you found them.

 Drive the visual and experiential direction of Make's most ambitious, net-new AI and agent initiatives — from first concept to shipped, polished product 
 Shape how Make's AI actually feels to use — designing the interaction patterns for things like agent behavior, steerability, and trust that don't have established conventions yet 
 Rapidly explore and prototype bold ideas; turn vague, open-ended problems into clear, testable directions others can rally around 
 Ground that boldness in real user needs — champion user-centric thinking, draw on and help shape user research, and keep the user at the center of ambitious bets 
 Turn both qualitative and quantitative data into insights that drive genuine innovation, not just validation 
 Set a high bar for craft, visual quality, motion, and polish on everything you touch — and lift the people around you by example 
 Partner closely with Product, Engineering, UX writers, researchers, and the teams building Make's AI capabilities: make your thinking visible early, bring people along, and land decisions through strong collaboration and stakeholder management 
 Contribute personally and hands-on, from concept through pixel-level refinement 
 Spot opportunities for genuinely bold creative direction — beyond incremental improvement

 Exceptional craft, visual taste, and attention to detail — a portfolio that is visually outstanding 
 A designer who does their best work in ambiguity and open-ended, exploratory problems, and is energized by starting from nothing
